sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手费尽心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Bristol is a vibrant, lively city in England's southwest, situated 169 kilometres west of London.
sentences.zh: 布里斯托是英国西南部一座充满活力、生机勃勃的城市，位于伦敦以西 169 公里处。

sentences.en: Blending rich maritime history with a modern, dynamic culture, the city hosts a range of
sentences.zh: 这座城市将丰富的航海历史与现代动感的文化融为一体，拥有各种

sentences.en: restaurants, museums, art galleries, festivals, and shopping districts, earning Bristol a reputation as one of the most cosmopolitan British cities outside of London.
sentences.zh: 餐馆、博物馆、艺术画廊、节日和购物区，这使得布里斯托享有伦敦以外最具国际大都市气息的英国城市之一的美誉。

sentences.en: Beyond its urban offerings, Bristol is known for its abundance of green spaces and parks, with the local community taking pride in the town's eco-friendly reputation.
sentences.zh: 除了城市的各种设施外，布里斯托还以其丰富的绿地和公园而闻名，当地社区为该镇的环保声誉感到自豪。

sentences.en: Residents are regarded as friendly and welcoming, with a strong sense of community spirit, making Bristol a great place to work and live.
sentences.zh: 居民们被认为友好热情，具有强烈的社区精神，这使得布里斯托成为一个工作和生活的绝佳地方。

sentences.en: The Bristol area has a moderate crime rate, scaling on the higher end when compared to other districts in the region, but this mostly concerns theft and drug offences.
sentences.zh: 布里斯托地区的犯罪率适中，与该地区的其他区相比处于较高水平，但这主要涉及盗窃和毒品犯罪。

sentences.en: Major violent crimes are rare, providing Bristol residents with the peace of mind that their community is safe and protected.
sentences.zh: 重大的暴力犯罪很罕见，这让布里斯托的居民感到安心，觉得他们的社区是安全和受到保护的。

sentences.en: This communal sense of security was shaken in late February 2015 by a Facebook post originating from Bristol.
sentences.zh: 2015 年 2 月下旬，一条发自布里斯托的 Facebook 帖子打破了这种社区安全感。

sentences.en: The post featured an image of a teenage girl, with the accompanying text reading,
sentences.zh: 帖子附有一张十几岁女孩的照片，配文写道，

sentences.en: Not long after, a second unsettling Facebook post was appearing across feeds.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，第二条令人不安的 Facebook 帖子出现在各大信息流中。

sentences.en: This one reading,
sentences.zh: 这条写道，

sentences.en: Within days, the original Facebook posts had been shared hundreds of times, and the hashtag findbecky was trending on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，最初的 Facebook 帖子就被分享了数百次，标签 #findbecky 在 Twitter 上成了热门话题。

sentences.en: Thousands of flyers were scattered throughout the streets of Bristol, featuring two candid photos of the missing teenage girl, who was making waves across social media.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的传单散落在布里斯托的街道上，上面印有这位在社交媒体上引起轰动的失踪少女的两张生活照。

sentences.en: The flyer read,
sentences.zh: 传单上写着，

sentences.en: We are appealing for the public's help to find missing teenager Rebecca Watts, who has gone missing in the St. George area of Bristol.
sentences.zh: 我们呼吁公众协助寻找失踪少女丽贝卡·沃茨，她在布里斯托的圣乔治地区失踪。

sentences.en: She went missing from the Crown Hill area on the morning of Thursday, February 19.
sentences.zh: 她于 2 月 19 日星期四上午从皇冠山地区失踪。

sentences.en: It is out of character for her not to contact someone if she is not returning home.
sentences.zh: 如果她不打算回家，却不跟任何人联系，这与她的性格不符。

sentences.en: Rebecca is described as a white girl, aged 16, about 5 foot 4 inches of slim build, with long reddish-brown hair.
sentences.zh: 据描述，丽贝卡是一个白人女孩，16岁，身高约 5 英尺 4 英寸，身材苗条，留着长长的红褐色头发。

sentences.en: She may be wearing a blue puffer-style jacket.
sentences.zh: 她可能穿着一件蓝色羽绒服。

sentences.en: We would like Rebecca, or anyone who knows where she is, to contact us, to confirm she is all right.
sentences.zh: 我们希望丽贝卡，或者任何知道她在哪里的 人与我们联系，以确认她平安无事。

sentences.en: Rebecca Marie Watts, known by friends and family as Becky, was born in Bristol on June 3, 1998.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡·玛丽·沃茨，朋友和家人称她为贝基，1998 年 6 月 3 日出生于布里斯托。

sentences.en: Even though her parents separated when she was just a baby, Becky had a special talent for ensuring her mum and dad always maintained a friendly relationship.
sentences.zh: 尽管在她还是个婴儿时父母就分开了，但贝基有一种特殊的才能，能确保她的爸爸妈妈始终保持友好的关系。

sentences.en: After her parents' separation, Becky and her older brother Daniel lived with their father,
sentences.zh: 父母分开后，贝基和哥哥丹尼尔跟着父亲一起生活，

sentences.en: Darren Galsworthy.
sentences.zh: 达伦·高尔斯沃西。

sentences.en: Darren doted on his little girl.
sentences.zh: 达伦对他的宝贝女儿疼爱有加。

sentences.en: On Becky's fourth birthday, Darren built her a garden playhouse where she could host elaborate fantasy-themed tea parties for her dolls and toys.
sentences.zh: 在贝基四岁生日时，达伦为她建造了一个花园游戏屋，她可以在那里为她的洋娃娃和玩具举办精心策划的奇幻主题茶会。

sentences.en: The closeness between the pair only strengthened over the years, with Darren becoming his daughter's number one supporter.
sentences.zh: 两人的亲密关系这些年来不断加深，达伦成了女儿头号支持者。

sentences.en: When Becky entered her teens and began suffering severe bouts of low self-esteem, Darren would assure her she was beautiful and promised that he would always be there for her.
sentences.zh: 当贝基进入青春期并开始遭受严重的自卑时，达伦向她保证她很漂亮，并承诺他会永远在她身边。

sentences.en: When Becky was just six months old, her father found love again with a woman named Angie.
sentences.zh: 贝基六个月大时，她的父亲遇到了另一个让他心动的女人，名叫安吉。

sentences.en: Darren was drawn to Angie's warm, loving persona and kind smile.
sentences.zh: 达伦被安吉温暖、充满爱意的个性和亲切的微笑所吸引。

sentences.en: Their relationship came naturally, with Darren describing it as two pieces of a jigsaw puzzle that fit together perfectly.
sentences.zh: 他们的感情水到渠成，达伦将其形容为两块完美契合的拼图。

sentences.en: Angie had a son of her own from a previous relationship.
sentences.zh: 安吉与前一段感情育有一个儿子。

sentences.en: Eleven-year-old Nathan Matthews, but she equally embraced Darren's two children as her own, taking on the role as a supportive stepmother.
sentences.zh: 11 岁的南森·马修斯，但她同样把达伦的两个孩子视如己出，扮演着一个充满支持的继母角色。

sentences.en: Others remarked that Angie's love was so immense, no one missed out.
sentences.zh: 其他人评论说，安吉的爱是如此浩瀚，没有人被冷落。

sentences.en: Through no fault of her own, Becky required constant reassurance, love and affection in her formative years, which Angie was quick to provide.
sentences.zh: 并非她自身的过错，贝基在成长岁月中需要持续的保证、爱和关怀，安吉很快便给予了满足。

sentences.en: This led Becky to develop a close bond with her stepmother, and the two became best friends.
sentences.zh: 这使得贝基与继母建立了紧密的联系，两人成了最好的朋友。

sentences.en: When Becky started primary school, her shyness prevented her from leaving Angie's side.
sentences.zh: 当贝基开始上小学时，她的害羞使她寸步不离安吉身边。

sentences.en: For the next four years, Angie volunteered to work as an unpaid teacher's aide at the school,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的四年里，安吉志愿去学校担任无薪助教，

sentences.en: just so she could remain close to her stepdaughter, offering the little girl comfort and support any time she needed it.
sentences.zh: 只为了能留在继女身边，在小女孩需要的时候随时给她安慰和支持。

sentences.en: Whenever they could, Angie and Darren would take Becky to the Bristol Zoo and other wildlife parks, sparking Becky's love of animals.
sentences.zh: 只要有可能，安吉和达伦就会带贝基去布里斯托动物园和其他野生动物公园，这激发了贝基对动物的热爱。

sentences.en: This affinity never faded.
sentences.zh: 这种喜爱从未消退。

sentences.en: Throughout her life, Becky owned several pets, including a cat, rabbit, turtle, hamsters and a rat.
sentences.zh: 在她的整个生命中，贝基养过几只宠物，包括一只猫、一只兔子、一只乌龟、仓鼠和一只大鼠。

sentences.en: Becky grew into a kind and sweet-natured 12-year-old.
sentences.zh: 贝基长成了一个善良、性格甜美的 12 岁女孩。

sentences.en: Although her transition into high school was difficult, as she was targeted by bullies who tormented her relentlessly.
sentences.zh: 虽然她过渡到高中的过程很艰难，因为她成为了霸凌者的目标，遭到无休止的折磨。

sentences.en: In one instance, a group of other students ripped Becky's brand new jacket right off her back.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一群其他学生直接把贝基崭新的夹克从背上撕了下来。

sentences.en: This was the last straw for Angie, who confronted the school principal demanding action.
sentences.zh: 这对安吉来说是忍无可忍的极限，她找到学校校长要求采取行动。

sentences.en: But her efforts to help only made things worse for Becky in the schoolyard.
sentences.zh: 但她提供帮助的努力反而在校园里让贝基的处境更加雪上加霜。

sentences.en: A few months into the school year,
sentences.zh: 开学几个月后，

sentences.en: Becky came home in tears, crying to her parents that she didn't have any friends and that nobody liked her.
sentences.zh: 贝基哭着回到家里，向父母哭诉自己没有朋友，没有人喜欢她。

sentences.en: Darren and Angie found this hard to believe, given that Becky was such a lovable young girl who was kind and gentle to everyone.
sentences.zh: 达伦和安吉觉得这很难相信，因为贝基是一个如此讨人喜欢的年轻女孩，对每个人都既善良又温和。

sentences.en: They assured her it would be a matter of time until the other kids saw just how wonderful she was.
sentences.zh: 他们向她保证，其他孩子迟早会看到她是多么棒。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the bullying continued, getting progressively worse as the year went on.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，霸凌仍在继续，随着这一年的过去，情况越来越严重。

sentences.en: After struggling to overcome issues with her negative body image, Becky was diagnosed
sentences.zh: 在努力克服负面身体形象带来的问题后，贝基被诊断出

sentences.en: with an eating disorder and social anxiety, which led to her developing a stronger dependency on Angie, along with a fear of leaving the house.
sentences.zh: 患有进食障碍和社交焦虑，这导致她对安吉产生了更强的依赖感，并对出门产生了恐惧。

sentences.en: Her father referred to these as very dark times, but the family worked through it together.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲称这些为非常黑暗的时期，但全家人一起度过了难关。

sentences.en: Darren Balsworthy, quote,
sentences.zh: 达伦·鲍尔斯沃西（注：原文如此），原话，

sentences.en: Becky was bullied about her weight and we almost lost her to anorexia.
sentences.zh: 贝基因为体重被霸凌，我们差点因为厌食症失去她。

sentences.en: But with a lot of care from us and hospital education, we were able to get our Becky back.
sentences.zh: 但在我们的大力照顾和医院教育下，我们得以找回我们的贝基。

sentences.en: When Becky was 13 years old, the family faced another challenge when Angie was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis.
sentences.zh: 当贝基 13 岁时，安吉被诊断出患有多发性硬化症，这个家庭面临着另一个挑战。

sentences.en: This chronic condition of the central nervous system interferes with nerve impulses within the brain,
sentences.zh: 这种中枢神经系统的慢性疾病会干扰大脑内部的神经冲动，

sentences.en: spinal cord and optic nerves, resulting in loss of sight, balance and muscle movement.
sentences.zh: 脊髓和视神经，导致视力、平衡和肌肉运动丧失。

sentences.en: Small household tasks started to present Angie a challenge and she struggled to go about her daily
sentences.zh: 繁琐的家务开始对安吉构成挑战，她的日常生活举步维艰，

sentences.en: life, unable to cook a meal or move around freely, clutching door frames to stop herself from falling over.
sentences.zh: 无法做饭或自由走动，只能抓着门框以防自己摔倒。

sentences.en: Becky saw this as an opportunity to reciprocate the love and support Angie had given her throughout her life.
sentences.zh: 贝基认为这是一个回报安吉一生中给予她的爱和支持的机会。

sentences.en: Darren provided Angie with a wheelchair and he and Becky would take turns bringing Angie for walks and helping to make her life as easy as possible.
sentences.zh: 达伦为安吉准备了一辆轮椅，他和贝基轮流带着安吉散步，并尽力让她的生活尽可能轻松。

sentences.en: Spirits were lifted in 2013 when Darren asked Angie to marry him.
sentences.zh: 2013年，达伦向安吉求婚，大家的情绪高涨。

sentences.en: Becky had developed an interest in fashion and a keen eye for style, so Darren and
sentences.zh: 贝基对时尚产生了兴趣，并且有着敏锐的时尚眼光，因此达伦和

sentences.en: Angie trusted her completely to choose the wedding dress, bridesmaids gowns and suits for the men.
sentences.zh: 安吉完全信任她来挑选婚纱、伴娘礼服和男士西装。

sentences.en: Becky chose her favourite colour as the theme for the big day.
sentences.zh: 贝基选择她最喜欢的颜色作为这个盛大日子的主题。

sentences.en: Blue.
sentences.zh: 蓝色。

sentences.en: By age 16, Becky lived with Darren and Angie in a two-storey terrace home on Crown Hill in St George, a district on the eastern edge of
sentences.zh: 到16岁时，贝基和达伦以及安吉一起住在布里斯托尔市界东部边缘一个名叫圣乔治的区的

sentences.en: Bristol's city boundary.
sentences.zh: 克朗山上一栋两层排屋里。

sentences.en: The trio were regularly visited by the couple's older sons, Nathan and Daniel, who had since grown up and moved out.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇已经长大并搬出去的年长儿子内森和丹尼尔会定期探望他们三人。

sentences.en: Nathan remained close, having started a family of his own in
sentences.zh: 内森和伴侣肖娜在布里斯托尔组建了自己的家庭，

sentences.en: Bristol with his partner, Shauna.
sentences.zh: 两人依然和家里保持着紧密的联系。

sentences.en: Shauna took on the role as Angie's full-time carer and would stop by the Goresworthies' Crown Hill home most days to check in on her mother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 肖娜担任安吉的全职护工，几乎每天都会顺道来到戈斯沃西家位于克朗山的住所探望她的婆婆。

sentences.en: Becky had since moved schools, a change that made an overwhelmingly positive impact on her life.
sentences.zh: 贝基后来转了学，这一改变对她的生活产生了极其积极的影响。

sentences.en: She was no longer bullied and instead formed a close-knit group of friends who spent lots of their spare time together, going to the
sentences.zh: 她不再遭受霸凌，而是结交了一群关系紧密的朋友，他们把许多业余时间花在一起，去

sentences.en: cinema, playing video games and hanging out at one another's homes.
sentences.zh: 电影院、玩电子游戏以及在彼此家中闲逛。

sentences.en: Inspired to help other students who were struggling to fit in at school, Becky took on a self-appointed mentorship role, spending her
sentences.zh: 为了帮助其他在学校难以融入集体的学生，贝基自发承担起导师的角色，利用

sentences.en: breaks talking to and giving advice to others, making sure no one else ever felt as vilified and alone as she once had.
sentences.zh: 课间休息时间与他人交谈并提供建议，确保其他人再也不会像她曾经那样感到受尽诋毁和孤立。

sentences.en: Becky commenced a relationship with 17-year-old Luke Oberhansley, a trainee car mechanic and long-time friend.
sentences.zh: 贝基与17岁的见习汽车修理工、多年的好友卢克·奥伯汉斯利确立了恋爱关系。

sentences.en: Regarded as a friendly and polite young man, Luke earned the appreciation of
sentences.zh: 卢克被认为是一个友好且有礼貌的年轻小伙，

sentences.en: Becky's parents as he treated their daughter with respect and kindness.
sentences.zh: 他对待贝基的女儿尊重而又温和，赢得了贝基父母的喜爱。

sentences.en: Becky was shy within big groups of people, but with Luke, she felt comfortable to be outgoing and funny.
sentences.zh: 贝基在大型群体中比较害羞，但和卢克在一起时，她感到很自在，能够展现出外向和有趣的一面。

sentences.en: By February 2015, the young couple had marked their four-month anniversary.
sentences.zh: 到2015年2月，这对年轻情侣迎来了他们的四个月纪念日。

sentences.en: They spent as much time together as they could and were in regular contact when they were apart, constantly sending each other text messages.
sentences.zh: 他们尽可能多地花时间在一起，分开时也保持着规律的联系，不断给对方发短信。

sentences.en: At 11.03am on
February 19, 2015, Luke's mobile phone buzzed, alerting him to a new text message from Becky, who he had listed in his phone contacts as, My Princess.
sentences.zh: 上午11点03分，卢克的手机震动了，提醒他收到了一条来自贝基的新短信。他在手机联系人里将贝基备注为“我的小公主”。

sentences.en: She was responding to Luke's text message from a minute earlier, where he had advised his girlfriend he was at home.
sentences.zh: 她是在回复卢克一分钟前发来的短信，当时卢克告知女友他在家里。

sentences.en: The message from Becky read, Goodie, followed by four kiss symbols and an affectionate emoji.
sentences.zh: 贝基发来的信息写着“太好了”，后面跟着四个亲吻符号和一个充满爱意的表情符号。

sentences.en: It was immediately followed by a second message from Becky, saying she was at her house, listening to music.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，贝基发来了第二条信息，说她在自己家里听音乐。

sentences.en: Luke was tempted to visit
sentences.zh: 卢克那天上午很想去

sentences.en: Becky that morning, but as he had made plans to see a dentist and get a haircut, he decided to catch up with Becky later in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 看望贝基，但因为他已经计划去看牙医和理发，便决定下午晚些时候再去找贝基。

sentences.en: At 12.09pm, Luke sent Becky a text message letting her know he had finished up with the dentiSt. When Becky didn't respond straight away, Luke presumed she was
sentences.zh: 中午12点09分，卢克给贝基发了一条短信，告知她自己已经看完了牙医。见贝基没有立刻回复，卢克猜想她

sentences.en: temporarily busy or distracted and would get back to him soon.
sentences.zh: 暂时在忙或者分心了，很快就会回复他。

sentences.en: When she still hadn't replied over half an hour later, Luke proceeded to send her a series of follow-up texts in a bid to get her attention.
sentences.zh: 半个多小时后她依然没有回复，于是卢克连续给她发了一系列后续短信，试图引起她的注意。

sentences.en: At 12.46pm, he messaged Becky, Oi.
sentences.zh: 中午12点46分，他给贝基发信息：“喂。”

sentences.en: She didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 她没有回复。

sentences.en: After nearly an hour passed, Luke messaged Becky again, saying,
sentences.zh: 将近一个小时过去后，卢克又给贝基发了信息，说：

sentences.en: Becky, Oi.
sentences.zh: “贝基，喂。”

sentences.en: Once again, his text was met with silence.
sentences.zh: 他的短信再次石沉大海。

sentences.en: Presuming his girlfriend must have been taking a nap, Luke waited and then a few hours later messaged Becky a third time,
sentences.zh: 卢克猜测女友一定是在睡午觉，便等了一会儿，几个小时后第三次给贝基发了信息：

sentences.zh: 那天下午，卢克按计划去当地的理发店理发，大约下午3点左右结束了预约。

sentences.en: He checked his phone, but there was still nothing from Becky.

sentences.en: Luke called Becky, but the line didn't ring, connecting him straight to her voicemail.
sentences.zh: 卢克给贝琪打了电话，但电话没有响铃，直接转入了语音信箱。

sentences.en: He suspected her phone battery must have died.
sentences.zh: 他猜测贝琪的手机电池可能没电了。

sentences.en: At around 5pm, Luke made the three-kilometre trip to
sentences.zh: 大约下午5点，卢克驱车三公里来到

sentences.en: Becky's house on Crown Hill to check if she was there.
sentences.zh: 位于皇冠山的贝琪家，想看看她在不在家。

sentences.en: Upon arriving, Luke noticed the black Vauxhall
sentences.zh: 抵达后，卢克注意到贝琪28岁的继兄内森的黑色沃克斯豪尔

sentences.en: Zephira car belonging to Becky's 28-year-old stepbrother Nathan was parked in the driveway, so he knew someone was at home.
sentences.zh: 齐菲拉轿车停在车道上，所以他知道家里有人。

sentences.en: Nathan's girlfriend, 21-year-old Shauna Hoare, answered the front door.
sentences.zh: 内森21岁女友肖娜·霍尔打开了前门。

sentences.en: As usual, Shauna was at the Crown Hill address providing daily care for Angie.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，肖娜在皇冠山的住处日常照顾安琪。

sentences.en: When Luke asked if Becky was home, Shauna wasn't certain.
sentences.zh: 当卢克问贝琪是否在家时，肖娜并不确定。

sentences.en: They inquired with Angie, but she wasn't sure either.
sentences.zh: 他们向安琪打听，但她也不太确定。

sentences.en: Neither woman had seen Becky all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 两个女人整个下午都没见过贝琪。

sentences.en: A quick check of Becky's bedroom confirmed she wasn't at the house.
sentences.zh: 简单检查一下贝琪的卧室后，确认她不在屋里。

sentences.en: Becky was an independent teenager who Angie and Darren trusted wholeheartedly, so she was allowed to come and go as she pleased.
sentences.zh: 贝琪是个独立的青少年，安琪和达伦对她百分之百信任，所以允许她自由出入。

sentences.en: While she usually told her parents where she was going and with whom, sometimes she left the house without letting anyone know her movements.
sentences.zh: 虽然她通常会告诉父母她要去哪里、和谁在一起，但有时她离开家时没有让任何人知道她的去向。

sentences.en: This didn't concern Angie and Darren, as Becky never ventured far away and only ever hung out with Luke or her close group of friends who they knew and trusted.
sentences.zh: 这并没有让安琪和达伦感到担心，因为贝琪从不走远，而且只和卢克或他们认识并信任的几个死党在一起。

sentences.en: However, the fact that Becky wasn't responding to text messages struck Angie as odd, as this was out of character.
sentences.zh: 然而，贝琪对短信毫无回应这一事实让安琪觉得很奇怪，因为这很不符合她的性格。

sentences.en: Luke also found it very unlike Becky not to be at home or be in contact with him when they had made plans to meet up.
sentences.zh: 卢克也觉得，既然他们已经约好了见面，贝琪不在家或不跟他联系，这太不像她的作风了。

sentences.en: She never cancelled their plans without telling him.
sentences.zh: 她从来没有在不通知他的情况下取消过两人的计划。

sentences.en: Assuming there must be a logical reason for Becky's lack of communication, Luke and Angie pushed their
sentences.zh: 卢克和安琪认为贝琪失联一定有合理的解释，于是将

sentences.zh: 担忧抛到了脑后，坚信她很快就会回家。

sentences.en: By 2.30pm the following day, Friday February 20, Becky still hadn't returned home.
sentences.zh: 第二天（2月20日星期五）下午2点30分，贝琪仍未回家。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for Becky to sleep over at a friend's place, all the more likely given it was school holidays.
sentences.zh: 贝琪在朋友家过夜并不是什么稀罕事，考虑到正值学校假期，这种可能性就更大了。

sentences.en: But as the hours passed, Becky failed to show up or make contact with anyone.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间流逝，贝琪始终没有露面，也没有和任何人取得联系。

sentences.en: Darren Galsworthy was at work when he received a phone call from his wife Angie asking if he had seen or heard from his daughter.
sentences.zh: 达伦·高尔斯沃西正在上班时接到了妻子安琪的电话，问他有没有见过或听到他女儿的消息。

sentences.en: Several of Becky's friends had gathered at their home on Crown Hill, worried that they hadn't seen or heard from Becky in over 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 贝琪的几个朋友聚集在他们位于皇冠山的家中，担心已经超过24小时没见到贝琪或听到她的消息了。

sentences.en: Darren checked Becky's Facebook page to see if she had recently posted a status update or uploaded a photo that would hint at her whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 达伦查看了贝琪的脸书主页，看她最近是否发布了状态更新或上传了能暗示她行踪的照片。

sentences.en: But she hadn't posted anything in the past 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 但她在过去24小时内没有发布任何内容。

sentences.en: Darren called Becky's mobile, but it was still going straight to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 达伦拨打了贝琪的手机，但依然直接转入语音信箱。

sentences.en: He left his daughter a message, asking,
sentences.zh: 他给女儿留了言，说道：

sentences.en: Becky, can you call me back and let me know where you are?
sentences.zh: 贝琪，能给我回个电话，告诉我你在哪儿吗？

sentences.en: Thanks, love.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Darren left work and made his way home.
sentences.zh: 达伦离开工作岗位，动身回家。

sentences.en: It was unlike Becky to leave home for this long without telling anyone where she was heading or when she expected to return.
sentences.zh: 贝琪离家这么久却不告诉任何人她要去哪里或预计何时回来，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Like most teenagers, she could be moody at times and often clashed with her parents, but overall she was sensible and loyal.
sentences.zh: 像大多数青少年一样，她有时也会闹情绪，经常与父母发生冲突，但总体来说她很懂事也很忠诚。

sentences.en: Not the type to run off.
sentences.zh: 不是那种会离家出走的人。

sentences.en: At the Galsworthy's home, discussions were underway as to Becky's possible whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 在高尔斯沃西的家里，大家正在讨论贝琪可能的去向。

sentences.en: Members of Becky's immediate family were joined by her boyfriend Luke and three of Becky's closest friends.
sentences.zh: 贝琪的直系亲属、男友卢克以及贝琪的三位挚友齐聚一堂。

sentences.en: The group reflected on
sentences.zh: 众人回想了

sentences.en: Becky's behaviour and mood in the days leading up to February 19, when she abruptly stopped messaging
sentences.zh: 贝姬在2月19日之前几天的行为和情绪，当时她突然停止给

sentences.en: Luke and vanished.
sentences.zh: 卢克发信息并且失踪了。

sentences.en: They all agreed that her demeanour was happy and carefree.
sentences.zh: 大家一致认为她平时的表现一直很开心、无忧无虑。

sentences.en: She gave no indication that she intended to leave home, nor did she provide information to anyone as to where she could have gone.
sentences.zh: 她没有任何迹象表明自己打算离家出走，也没有向任何人透露她可能去了哪里。

sentences.en: A timeline of Becky's last known movements was established.
sentences.zh: 一份关于贝姬最后已知行踪的时间线被整理了出来。

sentences.en: Luke had visited Becky at home two days earlier, on the night of Tuesday the 17th.
sentences.zh: 两天前的2月17日星期二晚上，卢克曾去家里探望过贝姬。

sentences.en: The pair hung out in Becky's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 两人在贝姬的卧室里闲逛。

sentences.en: Luke played video games on the television while Becky mucked around on his iPad.
sentences.zh: 卢克在电视上玩电子游戏，而贝姬则在他的iPad上瞎胡闹。

sentences.en: Luke left in the late evening, noting that
sentences.zh: 卢克在深夜离开，他注意到

sentences.zh: 派对结束后，两人回到亚当家看电影、打电子游戏。

sentences.en: We were just having a laugh really, as we always do.
sentences.zh: 我们其实就是一直在说说笑笑，就像我们平时那样。

sentences.en: Adam's statement was corroborated by Luke, who was texting back and forth with Becky throughout that night.
sentences.zh: 亚当的说法得到了卢克的证实，当晚卢克一直在和贝姬发短信聊天。

sentences.en: In her messages,
sentences.zh: 在她的信息中，

sentences.zh: 贝姬表现得很正常。

sentences.zh: 她给卢克的最后一条短信是在凌晨3点52分发出的。

sentences.en: It simply read, I love you so much.
sentences.zh: 内容很简单：我太爱你了。

sentences.en: Luke didn't reply as he was asleep at the time.
sentences.zh: 卢克当时睡着了，所以没有回复。

sentences.en: Becky slept the night at Adam's house, returning home early the next morning at around 8.30am, February 19.
sentences.zh: 贝姬在亚当家过夜，第二天一早也就是2月19日早上8点半左右回家。

sentences.zh: 安吉被贝姬用力敲前门的声音吵醒。

sentences.zh: 她需要别人开门，因为她的钥匙卡在门锁里了。

sentences.en: Becky spent the morning at home, where she recommenced texting with Luke.
sentences.zh: 贝姬在家待了整个上午，并重新开始和卢克发短信。

sentences.en: The pair discussing plans to meet up later that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 两人讨论了那天下午晚些时候见面的计划。

sentences.en: Becky was still home when Angie left for a scheduled doctor's appointment, sometime around 11am.
sentences.zh: 大约上午11点左右，安吉出门去参加预定好的医生预约时，贝姬还在家里。

sentences.en: Shortly after Angie had left for this doctor's appointment,
sentences.zh: 就在安吉出门去看医生后不久，

sentences.en: Galsworthy house for their routine visit.
sentences.zh: 高尔斯沃西家进行例行探访。

sentences.zh: 进屋后，这对夫妇没有和贝姬互动，但能听到她的房间里传出震耳欲聋的音乐声，这让他们觉得她在家里。

sentences.en: Nathan went straight into the lounge room and turned on a children's television program for his daughter, while Shauna stepped into the backyard to smoke a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 内森径直走进客厅为女儿打开了儿童电视节目，而肖娜则走到后院抽烟。

sentences.en: Around 15 to 20 minutes later, at approximately 11.30am, both Nathan and Shauna heard the music in Becky's room turn off.
sentences.zh: 大约15到20分钟后，即上午11点30分左右，内森和肖娜都听到贝姬房间的音乐声停了。

sentences.en: Not long after, they heard footsteps stomping down the staircase, followed by the front door being slammed.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们听到急促下楼的脚步声，接着是前门被重重关上的声音。

sentences.en: They both assumed Becky must have been in a bad mood and had left the house.
sentences.zh: 他们都以为贝姬肯定是心情不好，然后离开家了。

sentences.en: Angie returned home from the doctors at around 12.45pm.
sentences.zh: 安吉大约在下午12点45分从诊所回家。

sentences.en: At around 5pm, Luke visited the Galsworthy home and alerted them to Becky's lack of contact.
sentences.zh: 下午5点左右，卢克来到高尔斯沃西家，并提醒他们贝姬已经失联了。

sentences.en: Angie kept a vigil with the company of Nathan and
sentences.zh: 安吉在内森和

sentences.en: Shauna until Darren returned home from work.
sentences.zh: 肖娜的陪伴下一直守候着，直到达伦下班回家。

sentences.en: Although Becky didn't show up, the general consensus was she must have been spending the night elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 尽管贝姬没有出现，但大家的普遍共识是她肯定去别的地方过夜了。

sentences.en: At around 7pm, Nathan and Shauna left and Angie and
sentences.zh: 晚上7点左右，内森和肖娜离开，安吉和

sentences.zh: 达伦最终也上床睡觉了。

sentences.zh: 直到第二天下午2点，贝姬依然没有出现，也没有和任何人联系，大家的担忧达到了顶峰，所有人聚集在高尔斯沃西家，想弄清楚

sentences.en: she might be.
sentences.zh: 她可能在哪里。

sentences.en: He left another voicemail, pleading with his daughter to call or text to let everyone know she was safe.
sentences.zh: 他又留了一条语音留言，恳求女儿打电话或发短信让大家知道她是安全的。

sentences.zh: 随后众人搜查了贝姬的卧室。

sentences.en: Hers was a quintessential teenage girl's room.
sentences.zh: 这是一间典型的十几岁少女的房间。

sentences.en: The stark white walls were accentuated by a pink wardrobe, a cream-fluffy rug, and a silver-framed full-length mirror.
sentences.zh: 醒目的白墙配上粉色衣柜、奶油色毛绒地毯和银框全身镜，显得格外别致。

sentences.en: The pink window blinds were completely drawn.
sentences.zh: 粉色的百叶窗拉得严严实实。

sentences.en: A double bed was pushed into a far corner facing a television, with an adjacent bedside table containing a collection of candles.
sentences.zh: 一张双人床靠在正对电视的角落里，旁边紧挨着一张床头柜，上面摆放着一堆蜡烛。

sentences.en: A shelving unit displayed Becky's beloved items of makeup, perfume, jewellery, and a set of speakers, with a shoe rack underneath neatly stocked with trainers, heels, and multiple
sentences.zh: 一个置物架上摆放着贝姬心爱的化妆品、香水、首饰和一套音响，下方鞋架上整齐地摆放着运动鞋、高跟鞋和多

sentences.zh: 上面歪歪扭扭地写满了朋友们手写的祝福语和好运寄语。

sentences.en: In typical teenage fashion, the room was cluttered and somewhat messy, but everything appeared in its usual place.
sentences.zh: 带有典型的青少年风格，房间里有些杂乱，但一切似乎都放在它平时该放的位置。

sentences.en: A blue onesie pyjama outfit, a green jumper, and a blue puffer-style jacket.
sentences.zh: 一套蓝色连体睡衣、一件绿色套头衫和一件蓝色羽绒服。

sentences.en: However, the charging cables for all her tech devices were still there, as were Becky's purse, money, toothbrush, bags, and makeup kit.
sentences.zh: 然而，她所有电子设备的充电线都还在，贝姬的钱包、现金、牙刷、包和化妆包也都在。

sentences.en: Items she would usually take if she planned to spend a significant amount of time away from the house.
sentences.zh: 这些都是她如果打算离家一段时间通常会带走的物品。

sentences.en: As Becky's friends became increasingly distraught, Darren sent them home while he went door-knocking in the area to check if any neighbours had seen Becky around.
sentences.zh: 随着贝姬的朋友们愈发崩溃绝望，达伦让他们回去了，而自己则在社区挨家挨户敲门，看是否有邻居见过贝姬。

sentences.en: But none had.
sentences.zh: 但谁也没见过。

sentences.en: With no idea of her whereabouts or what to do next, Darren called the police and declared his daughter as a missing person.
sentences.zh: 在完全不知道她去向何方、接下来该做什么的情况下，达伦报了警，宣布他的女儿失踪了。

sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，达伦请继子内森帮他在Facebook上发一条动态。

sentences.zh: 内森按照达伦的口述打出这些字。

sentences.zh: 如果你见过她或知道任何情况，请发私信。

sentences.zh: 警察于当晚6点30分到达高尔斯沃西家。

sentences.zh: 警官询问了

sentences.en: design when she finished high school.

sentences.en: Taking matters into his own hands, he made phone calls to everyone he could think of who might know where Becky had gone.
