sentences.en: Becky's biological mother, Tanya Watts, confirmed she hadn't seen her daughter in over three weeks.
sentences.zh: 贝姬的生母坦娅·沃茨证实，她已经有三个多星期没见过女儿了。

sentences.en: Becky's older brother, Daniel, took the news of Becky's disappearance hard, as the day his sister was last seen coincided with his 20th birthday.
sentences.zh: 贝姬的哥哥丹尼尔很难接受妹妹失踪的消息，因为妹妹最后一次被人看见的那天正好是他的20岁生日。

sentences.en: Darren was kept awake that night with chilling thoughts that Becky may have been kidnapped after leaving the house to meet up with Luke.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上达伦辗转反侧，脑子里全是令人毛骨悚然的想法，担心贝姬离开家去见卢克后可能遭到了绑架。

sentences.en: Spurred by this fear, he called Becky's mobile phone once again, leaving another voice message directed at anyone who might have abducted her.
sentences.zh: 在这种恐惧的驱使下，他又一次拨打了贝姬的手机，留下了另一条语音留言，留言是说给任何可能绑架她的人听的。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: By the following morning of Saturday February 21, Darren's initial Facebook post requesting help to find Becky had been shared over 800 times.
sentences.zh: 到2月21日星期六上午，达伦最初发布的寻找贝姬的求助Facebook动态已经被转发了800多次。

sentences.en: He quickly created a follow-up post that read,
sentences.zh: 他迅速发了一条后续动态，上面写着：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: Please, if anyone has seen or heard from my daughter, just let me know she is safe.
sentences.zh: 求求大家，如果有人看到或听到我女儿的消息，请告诉我她是安全的。

sentences.en: She went missing on Thursday February 19 at 11.15am to meet her boyfriend, and never arrived.
sentences.zh: 她在2月19日星期四上午11点15分离家去见男友，但从未到达。

sentences.en: She hasn't been seen by any of her friends.
sentences.zh: 她的任何朋友都没有见过她。

sentences.en: Police have started a search.
sentences.zh: 警方已经展开搜寻。

sentences.en: I'm really scared now.
sentences.zh: 我现在真的很害怕。

sentences.en: I want her home.
sentences.zh: 我想让她回家。

sentences.en: As the disappearance of Becky Watts gained national attention across social media, a team of eight detectives showed up to the Gaulsworthy home to begin an official search for
sentences.zh: 随着贝姬·沃茨失踪事件在社交媒体上引起全国关注，八名侦探组成的团队来到高尔斯沃西家，开始对这名

sentences.en: the teenager.
sentences.zh: 少女展开正式搜查。

sentences.en: As Becky hadn't accessed her phone or contacted friends or family since the morning of
sentences.zh: 由于贝姬自失踪当天早上以来就再也没有使用过手机，也没有联系过亲友，

sentences.en: her disappearance, Detective Chief Inspector Richard Acone instinctually believed this wasn't just a case of a misbehaving teen.
sentences.zh: 侦探总督察理查德·阿康凭直觉认为这绝不仅仅是一起青少年不听话的案子。

sentences.en: He had a strong suspicion Becky had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 他强烈怀疑贝姬遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, when police started publicising the case on Sunday February 22, their focus was on promoting Becky's
sentences.zh: 然而，当警方在2月22日星期日开始公开这起案件时，他们的重点是宣传贝姬

sentences.en: disappearance and encouraging locals to be on the lookout, as opposed to suggesting the 16-year-old was in any danger.
sentences.zh: 失踪的消息并鼓励当地居民多加留意，而不是暗示这名16岁的女孩处于任何危险之中。

sentences.en: They started a social media campaign using Becky's photo along with the hashtag
sentences.zh: 他们发起了社交媒体活动，使用贝姬的照片并带上

sentences.en: Find Becky.
sentences.zh: 寻找贝姬（Find Becky）的话题标签。

sentences.en: Police emphasised the fact that it was out of character for Becky not to be in contact with
sentences.zh: 警方强调了一个事实，即贝姬不与亲友

sentences.en: friends or family, adding that she might be wearing a blue puffer-style jacket, the one noticed missing from her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 联系很不符合她的性格，并补充说她可能穿着一件蓝色羽绒服，也就是从她卧室里失的那件。

sentences.en: A press conference was held the following day, on Monday February 23.
sentences.zh: 第二天，即2月23日星期星期一，举行了一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Darren
sentences.zh: 达伦

sentences.en: Gaulsworthy was asked to appeal directly to his daughter, on the chance she had run away and was scared to return home due to the police and media attention.
sentences.zh: ·高尔斯沃西被要求直接向女儿喊话，以防她是离家出走，且因为警方和媒体的关注而害怕回家。

sentences.en: Bex, if you're watching this, please come home.
sentences.zh: 贝克斯，如果你在看这个，请回家吧。

sentences.en: We love you so much and whatever you think, we can sort anything out the matter, just come home.
sentences.zh: 我们太爱你了，不管你怎么想，天大的事我们都能解决，只要回家就行。

sentences.en: And if any of her friends are riding her, you're not doing any favours.
sentences.zh: 如果她的朋友里有人在藏着她，你们可真不是在帮她。

sentences.en: Just tell the police.
sentences.zh: 只要告诉警察就行。

sentences.en: Just bring number 101 and just bring her own safe.
sentences.zh: 只要拨打101，把她平平安安带回来就行。

sentences.en: Darren broke down and was unable to continue.
sentences.zh: 达伦情绪崩溃，泣不成声无法继续。

sentences.en: So Becky's grandmother, Pat, took over.
sentences.zh: 于是贝姬的祖母帕特接过了话筒。

sentences.en: Hi Bex, it's Nan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，贝克斯，我是奶奶。

sentences.en: You can see you're dancing.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到你在跳舞。

sentences.en: It's a broken man.
sentences.zh: 这是一个心碎的男人。

sentences.en: Please just, if you don't want to come home yet, just, just let someone else ring or text someone.
sentences.zh: 求求你，如果你现在还不想回家，只要，只要让别人打个电话或发个短信给某个人就行。

sentences.en: And if you want, if you're a bit worried about coming back because of all this hullabaloo, come and stay with me for a few days.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，如果你因为这场轩然大波而有点担心回来，就来我这里住几天吧。

sentences.en: You know I've got a spare room.
sentences.zh: 你知道我有一间客房的。

sentences.en: But you will, you're so loved.
sentences.zh: 但是你会明白，你是如此被爱着。

sentences.en: And I don't think you believe it.
sentences.zh: 而我想你并不相信这一点。

sentences.en: You really are so loved.
sentences.zh: 你真的是被深深爱着的。

sentences.en: And look at your poor dad.
sentences.zh: 看看你可怜的爸爸吧。

sentences.en: Please come home or whoever's sheltering here.
sentences.zh: 请回家吧，或者无论谁在庇护你。

sentences.en: Do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 做正确的事吧。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Inspector Richard O'Cone wrapped up the conference.
sentences.zh: 侦探总督察理查德·奥康总结了这场发布会。

sentences.en: First, I just want to say to Becky, you're not in any trouble.
sentences.zh: 首先，我只想对贝姬说，你没有任何麻烦。

sentences.en: We're all concerned about your well-being and we just want to make sure that you're okay.
sentences.zh: 我们都很关心你的健康，我们只想确保你是安全的。

sentences.en: If you can call home or one of your friends or phone us, the police on 101 and just confirm where you are and let us know you're okay,
sentences.zh: 如果你能给家里、你的某个朋友打电话，或者拨打警察局电话101并确认你的位置，让我们知道你没事，

sentences.en: we can help work through any issues that you might be facing.
sentences.zh: 我们就能帮你度过你可能面临的任何问题。

sentences.en: I would also ask anyone who might have any information about where Rebecca is to come forward and talk to us.
sentences.zh: 我也想请任何掌握丽贝卡去向线索的人站出来和我们谈谈。

sentences.en: After the press conference,
sentences.zh: 新闻发布会结束后，

sentences.en: Darren agreed to an interview with Jack FM, a popular Bristol radio station.
sentences.zh: 达伦同意接受布里斯托尔热门广播电台杰克调频（Jack FM）的采访。

sentences.en: He told the host of the show, quote,
sentences.zh: 他对节目主持人说，原话是：

sentences.en: Becky's very shy and timid.
sentences.zh: 贝姬非常害羞和胆小。

sentences.en: Not around us and her closest friends, but anyone outside of that and she wouldn't be able to talk to them.
sentences.zh: 在我们和她最要好的朋友面前不这样，但面对圈子以外的任何人，她都说不出话来。

sentences.en: As I have told the police, she can't even go up to a till in a shop.
sentences.zh: 正如我告诉警察的那样，她甚至不敢走到商店的收银台前。

sentences.en: She couldn't even ask for a bus ticket.
sentences.zh: 她甚至不敢要求买一张公交车票。

sentences.en: She would rather walk than get on a bus and ask the driver for a ticket.
sentences.zh: 她宁愿走路也不愿上车去向司机要张票。

sentences.en: This is how shy and reserved she is.
sentences.zh: 这就是她多么害羞和内向。

sentences.en: So this just doesn't add up.
sentences.zh: 所以这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Members of Becky's family organised a public search around Bristol's St George area, where more than 100 locals volunteered their assistance.
sentences.zh: 贝姬的家属在布里斯托尔圣乔治地区组织了一场公众搜寻活动，100多名当地居民自愿提供帮助。

sentences.en: Volunteers were separated into smaller groups and sent in different directions to cover as much ground as possible, handing out over 8,000 flyers as they went.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们被分成较小的小组，分头前往不同的方向以覆盖尽可能多的区域，一路上散发了8000多份传单。

sentences.en: Those closest to Becky, including members of her immediate family and friendship circle, were questioned at length by police.
sentences.zh: 那些与贝姬最亲近的人，包括她的直系亲属和朋友圈的成员，都受到了警方长时间的盘问。

sentences.en: But again, nothing was gained to suggest Becky's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 但同样，没有任何线索能够暗示贝姬的下落。

sentences.en: Her online movements, chat logs, text messages, phone records and social media accounts were checked, but nothing suspicious or helpful arose.
sentences.zh: 警方检查了她的网络动态、聊天记录、短信、通话记录以及社交媒体账号，但没有发现任何可疑或有价值的线索。

sentences.en: The last time Becky had accessed her Facebook account was on the morning of her disappearance and it hadn't been touched since.
sentences.zh: 贝基上一次登录脸书账号是在她失踪那天早晨，此后再也没有动过。

sentences.en: The last text messages sent from her phone were the ones to Luke and another friend, just after 11am on Thursday February 19.
sentences.zh: 她手机发送的最后几条短信是发给卢克和另一个朋友的，时间是在2月19日星期四上午11点刚过。

sentences.en: With no sign of
sentences.zh: 在毫无

sentences.en: Becky, five different police jurisdictions were now involved in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 贝基踪迹的情况下，目前已有五个不同的警察管辖区介入了调查。

sentences.en: South Wales,
sentences.zh: 南威尔士、

sentences.en: Wiltshire, Devon and Cornwell, with Bristol Police at the helm.
sentences.zh: 威尔特郡、德文郡和康沃尔，由布里斯托尔警方牵头。

sentences.en: They were assisted by search and missing persons experts from the National Crime Agency, College of Policing and various national missing persons organisations.
sentences.zh: 来自国家犯罪局、警务学院及各大全国失踪人员组织的搜救和失踪人口专家也协助了他们。

sentences.en: During the course of the search, two police dive teams combed through ponds in nearby parks and nature reserves.
sentences.zh: 在搜寻过程中，两支警方潜水队对附近公园和自然保护区内的池塘进行了地毯式搜查。

sentences.en: 26 buildings were rented, 328 houses were door-knocked, 300 back gardens and outhouses were searched and another 100 areas of the city were inspected.
sentences.zh: 他们租用了26栋建筑，对328户人家进行了走访，搜查了300个后花园和附属建筑，并对该市另外100个区域进行了勘查。

sentences.en: At one point, over 500 officers were actively involved in the case, making the search to find Becky Watts the largest missing person case in the county's history.
sentences.zh: 一度有超过500名警员积极参与此案，这使得搜寻贝基·沃茨的行动成为该郡历史上规模最大的失踪人口搜救案。

sentences.en: But still, the police were no closer to finding any sign of the teenager.
sentences.zh: 然而，警方依然没有找到任何关于这名少年的蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: The online police campaign promoting Becky Watts' disappearance had reached more than two million people across the world, gaining global attention for the case.
sentences.zh: 呼吁寻找贝基·沃茨的警方网络宣传活动已触及全球两百多万人，使该案受到了全球关注。

sentences.en: Yet, despite all efforts,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管付出了种种努力，

sentences.en: Becky remained missing.
sentences.zh: 贝基依然下落不明。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, forensic investigators examining the Gullsworthy's Crown Hill property picked up something of note in Becky's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对高斯沃西家族位于克朗山住所进行勘查的法医调查人员，在贝基的卧室里发现了一个值得注意的情况。

sentences.en: Although near impossible to see with the naked eye, forensic testing detected red staining on the architrave leading into Becky's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 尽管用肉眼几乎无法察觉，但法医检测发现，通往贝基卧室的门框上带有红色血迹。

sentences.en: The staining appeared in spatter-like patterns at different heights, some low, some waist height, and some shoulder height.
sentences.zh: 这些血迹呈喷溅状分布在不同高度，有些较低，有些处于腰部高度，还有些达到肩膀高度。

sentences.en: Found within the staining was a set of red fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 在血迹中还发现了一组红色的指纹。

sentences.en: Initial testing confirmed the substance was human blood, but it would take time to determine who it and the fingerprints belonged to.
sentences.zh: 初步检测证实该物质是人类血液，但要确定血液和指纹的主人是谁尚需时日。

sentences.en: Analysis of the blood spatter revealed the pattern was consistent with a struggle having taken place in the vicinity of Becky's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 对血迹喷溅情况的分析表明，其形态与贝基卧室附近曾发生过挣扎的情况相符。

sentences.en: However, Becky's older stepbrother,
sentences.zh: 然而，贝基较大的继兄，

sentences.en: Nathan Matthews, and his long-term partner, Shawna Hoare, had been in the house with Becky on the morning of her disappearance and did not report hearing an altercation take place.
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯和他的长期伴侣肖娜·霍尔，在贝基失踪那天早晨和她同在一栋房子里，却并未报告曾听到发生过争吵。

sentences.en: If the blood on the doorframe belonged to Becky Watts, it seemed highly unlikely the 16-year-old simply walked out of her family home on the late morning of Thursday, February 19.
sentences.zh: 如果门框上的血迹属于贝基·沃茨，那么这位16岁女孩在2月19日星期四的深夜独自走出家族住宅的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《罪案档案》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: Nathan Matthews and Shawna Hoare's accounts of Thursday,
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯和肖娜·霍尔对2015年2月19日星期四这一天的

sentences.en: February 19, 2015, matched word for word.
sentences.zh: 描述字字吻合。

sentences.en: For Detective Chief Inspector Richard O'Cone, the couple's identical stories drew his immediate suspicions.
sentences.zh: 在高级侦探督察理查德·奥康看来，这对情侣完全一致的说法立即引起了他的怀疑。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: They were really consistent in their accounts.
sentences.zh: 他们的说法非常一致。

sentences.en: However, the detective's side of my brain was saying that they fit together really conveniently and neatly.
sentences.zh: 然而，我身为侦探的直觉告诉我，这些说辞串通得实在是太方便、太整齐了。

sentences.en: Even the best witnesses will provide accounts that are incorrect.
sentences.zh: 即便是最好的证人，也会提供不准确的陈述。

sentences.en: In the initial stages of the investigation into Becky Watts' disappearance, Nathan and Shawna were asked to participate in police interviews, but efforts
sentences.zh: 在调查贝基·沃茨失踪案的初期阶段，警方曾要求内森和肖娜配合接受警方问询，但由于他们始终抽不出时间，

sentences.en: to meet with the couple were delayed as they were consistently unavailable.
sentences.zh: 与两人会面的努力一再被延迟。

sentences.en: One such request happened on Monday, February 23, four days into the search for Becky.
sentences.zh: 其中一次约谈发生在2月23日星期一，当时搜寻贝基的工作已经进行了四天。

sentences.en: Shawna declined to meet with police, explaining her and Nathan had made dinner plans with her mother.
sentences.zh: 肖娜拒绝与警方会面，解释说她和内森已经和她母亲做好了共进晚餐的计划。

sentences.en: Shawna's mother Lisa was surprised when her daughter called her out of the blue to organise a visit that day, arriving at her property in South Mead with Nathan within the hour.
sentences.zh: 肖娜的母亲丽莎接到女儿突如其来的电话，安排当天的探访时感到很惊讶，内森陪同她在不到一小时内就抵达了她位于南米德的住所。

sentences.en: By the fifth day of the investigation, police were no longer willing to wait for Nathan and Shawna's cooperation.
sentences.zh: 到调查的第五天，警方不再愿意等待内森和肖娜的配合了。

sentences.en: Two detective constables visited Cotton Mill Lane in the Button Hill district of Bristol,
sentences.zh: 两名侦探警员走访了布里斯托尔邦顿山地区的科顿米尔巷，

sentences.en: knocking on the front door of a council-owned terraced flat where Nathan and Shawna lived with their two-year-old child.
sentences.zh: 敲响了一栋由地方议会所有、内森和肖娜与他们两岁孩子共同居住的排屋公寓的前门。

sentences.en: When Nathan answered the door, he looked noticeably tired and pale with dark circles framing his eyes.
sentences.zh: 内森开门时，看起来明显很疲惫，脸色苍白，眼眶深陷。

sentences.en: Yet, upon greeting the detectives, he perked up and was welcoming and talkative, inviting the officers inside.
sentences.zh: 然而，一看到侦探，他又振作了起来，表现得热情且健谈，并邀请警官们进屋。

sentences.en: Before they entered, he apologised for the state of his house.
sentences.zh: 在他们进去之前，他为家里杂乱的状况道了歉。

sentences.en: From the outside, their property looked completely normal.
sentences.zh: 从外表上看，他们的住所完全正常。

sentences.en: The mixed red brick and dark timber two-storey flat had a neat and tidy exterior.
sentences.zh: 这栋双层公寓采用红砖与深色木材混搭，外观整洁。

sentences.en: However, the interior was a starkly different story.
sentences.zh: 然而，内部情况却截然不同。

sentences.en: Inside, the detective constables were confronted by a disgusting scene of squalor and filth, accompanied by a strong stench of cat feces.
sentences.zh: 一进门，侦探警员们便面对着一幅肮脏污秽、令人作呕的景象，空气中还弥漫着浓烈的猫粪恶臭。

sentences.en: Nathan and Shawna's home could only be described as that of hoarders, with each room filled from floor to ceiling with junk, random pieces of furniture,
sentences.zh: 内森和肖娜的家只能用囤积狂的住所来形容，每个房间从地板到天花板都塞满了杂物、各种随意的家具、

sentences.en: broken electrical items, toys, dirty dishes, boxes, and takeaway food containers.
sentences.zh: 损坏的电器、玩具、脏盘子、纸箱以及外卖食品盒。

sentences.en: Efforts to enter through the front door were hindered by belongings, including a pram, toys, a two-foot-tall fridge, plastic bags, and a cat crate.
sentences.zh: 想要从前门进入受到了各种物品的阻碍，包括婴儿车、玩具、两英尺高的冰箱、塑料袋和猫笼。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Simon Wallace, quote,
sentences.zh: 侦探警员西蒙·华莱士引述：

sentences.en: It was hard to envisage a family living comfortably at the address due to the volume of clutter scattered around the house.
sentences.zh: 鉴于屋里到处散落着大量杂物，很难想象一个家庭能在这个地址舒适地生活。

sentences.en: I don't believe the downstairs could have been used.
sentences.zh: 我认为楼下根本无法使用。

sentences.en: There was nowhere to sit and no way to gain access to the kitchen facilities.
sentences.zh: 那里没有坐的地方，也无法使用厨房设施。

sentences.en: Nathan explained the clutter was due to his habit of bringing home discarded items he believed he could fix up to use or sell.
sentences.zh: 内森解释说，这些杂物是因为他有把丢弃物品带回家的习惯，他认为自己可以修好它们来使用或出售。

sentences.en: However, it appeared he never bothered to repair anything.
sentences.zh: 然而，他似乎从没费心去修理过任何东西。

sentences.en: Strewn among his overwhelming collection of useless junk were empty soda cans, cat food tins, yogurt containers, and other household trash, while a pile of unwashed
sentences.zh: 在他那堆浩如烟海的无用杂物中，散落着空苏打罐、猫粮罐头、酸奶盒和其他生活垃圾，而厨房水槽里还堆着一堆无人理睬的

sentences.en: dishes lay ignored in the kitchen sink.
sentences.zh: 未清洗的盘子。

sentences.en: Nathan claimed he had recently been diagnosed with fibromyalgia, a disease that affects the nervous system and triggers severe pain in various parts of the body,
sentences.zh: 内森声称自己最近被诊断出患有纤维肌痛，这是一种影响神经系统并在身体各处引发剧烈疼痛的疾病，

sentences.en: rendering him unable to hold a full-time job.
sentences.zh: 这导致他无法从事全职工作。

sentences.en: He worked part-time as a delivery driver for a local Chinese restaurant, but hadn't taken a shift in recent days.
sentences.zh: 他在当地一家中餐馆兼职做送货司机，但最近几天都没有去上班。

sentences.en: His partner, Sean O'Hor, was raising the couple's two-year-old daughter, whilst also earning an income as the full-time carer for Nathan's mother, Angie.
sentences.zh: 他的伴侣肖娜·霍尔负责抚养两人两岁的女儿，同时还担任内森母亲安吉的全职护工来赚取收入。

sentences.en: Nathan led the officers to an upstairs bedroom, pushing past a mattress that lay hunched over the stairs.
sentences.zh: 内森带着警官们来到楼上的卧室，拨开了一个倚在楼梯上的床垫。

sentences.en: The bedroom was piled high with all sorts of clutter, the walkway to the bed the only clear area with enough remaining space for the three to stand together and talk.
sentences.zh: 卧室里堆满了各种杂物，通往床铺的过道是唯一干净的区域，仅剩下足够三人站在一起交谈的空间。

sentences.en: A toaster, kettle, and condiments sat on one side of the double bed, a makeshift kitchen as the real one was inaccessible.
sentences.zh: 双人床的一侧放着烤面包机、电水壶和调味品，由于真正的厨房无法进入，这里成了一个临时厨房。

sentences.en: Shauna was inside the bedroom sitting on the bed, but interacted very little with the detectives.
sentences.zh: 肖娜正坐在卧室的床上，但与侦探们的互动非常少。

sentences.en: Nathan repeated his version of events on the late morning of Thursday February 19.
sentences.zh: 内森重复了他在2月19日星期四深夜的那套说辞。

sentences.en: He was certain
sentences.zh: 他确信

sentences.en: Becky left the Gaulsworthy house shortly after he and Shauna arrived, but maintained not seeing or interacting with her in the short time all three were inside.
sentences.zh: 贝基在他和肖娜到达后不久就离开了高斯沃西家的房子，但坚称在三人同处屋内的短时间内，他没有看到贝基也没有与她互动。

sentences.en: The detectives wandered through Nathan and Shauna's home, tailed by Nathan, who allowed them to see each room.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在内森和肖娜的家中四处查看，内森则尾随其后，允许他们参观每个房间。

sentences.en: Possessions were piled on tables and chairs, towering over the group as they navigated through narrow pathways between the junk.
sentences.zh: 桌椅上堆满了物品，当他们在杂物之间的狭窄通道中穿行时，这些杂物高高耸立在他们头顶。

sentences.en: Eventually, they reached the only door in the house that was shut.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们来到了屋里唯一一扇关着的门前。

sentences.en: It led into the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 门后通往浴室。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Simon Wallace, quote,
sentences.zh: 侦探警员西蒙·华莱士引述：

sentences.en: The bathroom window was open.
sentences.zh: 浴室的窗户开着。

sentences.en: The actual bath itself was clear.
sentences.zh: 浴缸本身很干净。

sentences.en: There was nothing on it or on the sides at all.
sentences.zh: 上面或边缘什么也没有。

sentences.en: The bath was clean.
sentences.zh: 浴缸被打扫得很干净。

sentences.en: Feeling the heat of the investigative spotlight, the cagey and uncooperative
sentences.zh: 感受到调查聚光灯的炙烤，原本闪烁其词且不愿配合的

sentences.en: Nathan Matthews and Shauna Hoare suddenly volunteered to participate in formal police interviews.
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯和肖娜·霍尔突然主动提出参与正式的警方问讯。

sentences.en: On Friday February 27, the eighth day of Becky's disappearance, the couple were separated into different interview rooms and questioned at length about the missing teen.
sentences.zh: 2月27日星期五，即贝基失踪的第八天，这对情侣被分开关押在不同的审讯室里，并就这名失踪少女接受了长时间的盘问。

sentences.en: Nathan spoke of his relationship with his younger stepsister, explaining that they were civil and bonded occasionally by venting
sentences.zh: 内森谈到了他与这位年轻继妹的关系，解释说他们关系客气，偶尔会通过宣泄

sentences.en: about problems in their lives, but weren't particularly close.
sentences.zh: 各自生活中的问题来建立联系，但并不是特别亲密。

sentences.en: They weren't even friends on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至都不是脸书好友。

sentences.en: It wasn't always this way.
sentences.zh: 情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: The step-siblings were close when they were much younger.
sentences.zh: 这两个继兄妹在很小的时候关系很近。

sentences.en: When Nathan's mother Angie moved in with her new beau, Darren Galsworthy, she didn't want to uproot her son from
sentences.zh: 当内森的母亲安吉搬去和她的新男友达伦·高斯沃西同居时，她不想让儿子离开他已经适应的

sentences.en: the area he was settled in, so he remained living with his grandmother.
sentences.zh: 社区，所以他继续和祖母住在一起。

sentences.en: Despite the separation,
sentences.zh: 尽管分居两地，

sentences.en: Nathan was still treated as a key member of the family, and was regarded as the big brother.
sentences.zh: 内森依然被视为家庭的核心成员，并被认为是

sentences.en: to Daniel and Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔和贝基·沃茨的大哥。

sentences.en: He'd visit regularly, and as the eldest, he would often escort his younger step-siblings to an adventure playground.
sentences.zh: 他会定期探访，作为长兄，他经常陪同年轻的继弟妹去冒险游乐场。

sentences.en: Becky didn't learn to speak clearly until she was three years old, with the first fully formed word to come out of her mouth being, Nathan.
sentences.zh: 贝基直到三岁才学会清晰说话，她嘴里说出的第一个完整的词就是“内森”。

sentences.en: Although
sentences.zh: 尽管

sentences.en: Nathan was regarded as a normal, well-adjusted child, others noticed he gradually changed as he grew older, becoming a loner with a short temper.
sentences.zh: 内森被视为一个正常、适应良好的孩子，但其他人注意到他随着年龄的增长逐渐发生了变化，变得孤僻且脾气暴躁。

sentences.en: At age 13, he joined the army cadets, and went on to have an active role in the army reserves throughout his late teens and early 20s.
sentences.zh: 13岁时，他加入了陆军青年军校学员队，并在其青少年时期到20岁出头这段时间里，在陆军预备役中扮演了活跃的角色。

sentences.en: It was during these later years when the relationship between Becky and Nathan began to sour.
sentences.zh: 正是在这些后来的岁月里，贝基和内森的关系开始恶化。

sentences.en: Darren Galsworthy always sensed there was an underlying tension between his daughter and stepson as they vied for Angie's attention.
sentences.zh: 达伦·高斯沃西一直隐约感觉到，他的女儿和继子在争夺安吉的关注时，两人之间存在着一种潜在的紧张关系。

sentences.en: As such, the step-siblings clashed quite often.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对继兄妹经常发生冲突。

sentences.en: Nathan would snap at Becky for carelessly leaving things lying around the house that his mother could potentially trip over.
sentences.zh: 内森会因为贝基漫不经心地把东西扔在屋里、可能导致他母亲绊倒而对她发脾气。

sentences.en: He also drew issue with
sentences.zh: 他还对

sentences.en: Becky's eating disorder, believing that she used it as a means to manipulate Angie for sympathy and attention.
sentences.zh: 贝基的饮食失调症提出异议，认为她以此来操纵安吉以博取同情和关注。

sentences.en: He considered Becky selfish and harbored jealousy towards her for what he perceived to be a spoiled upbringing in comparison to his own.
sentences.zh: 他认为贝基很自私，并对她心生嫉妒，因为他觉得与自己的经历相比，贝基是在一种被宠坏的环境中长大的。

sentences.en: These tensions didn't escalate beyond common sibling rivalry, but worked to cause distance between the once-closed pair.
sentences.zh: 这些紧张关系没有超出普通的手足竞争，但却导致这对曾经亲密的搭档渐行渐远。

sentences.en: When asked if he had helped search for his stepsister, Nathan responded, quote,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他是否曾帮忙寻找他的继妹时，内森回答说，引述：

sentences.en: I haven't actually gone out to search, no.
sentences.zh: 我实际上并没有出去找，没有。

sentences.en: Obviously I've gone out to the shop, but I haven't seen her on the way.
sentences.zh: 我当然去过商店，但在路上没见过她。

sentences.en: Nobody seems to notify us of what's going on.
sentences.zh: 似乎没人通知我们发生了什么事。

sentences.en: It's one of those things.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: You've got to wait.
sentences.zh: 你必须等待。

sentences.en: Becky doesn't talk to me about her life, the things she does.
sentences.zh: 贝基不跟我谈论她的生活以及她做的事。

sentences.en: The day before Becky went missing, she went out and didn't let my mum know where she was.
sentences.zh: 在贝基失踪的前一天，她外出了，却没有让我妈妈知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: Nathan couldn't recall when he last spoke to
sentences.zh: 内森记不清他最后一次和

sentences.en: Becky, adding that it had been more than six months since the two even exchanged text messages.
sentences.zh: 贝基说话是什么时候了，并补充说两人甚至已经有六个多月没有互发短信了。

sentences.en: Unlike her partner, Shauna Hoare was far more positive in describing her relationship with Becky.
sentences.zh: 与她的伴侣不同，肖娜·霍尔在描述她与贝基的关系时要积极得多。

sentences.en: Although the two weren't particularly close, Shauna admitted that she was finding Becky's disappearance quite hard.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人并不是特别亲密，但肖娜承认，贝基的失踪让她感到很难受。

sentences.en: The girls had become like family, both standing by Angie's side during her wedding to Darren, serving as bridesmaids in the blue gowns selected by Becky.
sentences.zh: 这两个女孩已经情同姐妹，都在安吉与达伦的婚礼上陪伴在侧，并穿着由贝基挑选的蓝色礼服担任伴娘。

sentences.en: Although Shauna described Becky as a nice girl, she held similar opinions to Nathan that the teenager was spoiled and selfish.
sentences.zh: 尽管肖娜形容贝基是个好女孩，但她和内森有着相似的看法，认为这名少年被惯坏了而且很自私。

sentences.en: It was behaviour Shauna resented as she carried the scars of a broken home and saw Becky as ungrateful for her privileged upbringing.
sentences.zh: 这种行为引起了肖娜的愤恨，因为她背负着破碎家庭的创伤，并认为贝基对她优越的成长环境不知感恩。

sentences.en: Along with her seven siblings, Shauna had grown up in foster care, living with six different foster families throughout her childhood
sentences.zh: 除了七个兄弟姐妹外，肖娜是在寄养家庭中长大的，在童年时期曾在六个不同的寄养家庭生活过，

sentences.en: before returning to the custody of her mother at age 13.
sentences.zh: 直到13岁时才回到母亲的抚养下。

sentences.en: She began a relationship with Nathan Matthews one year later, moving out when she was 17 years old and soon losing touch with her mother over an argument regarding a car.
sentences.zh: 一年后，她开始与内森·马修斯交往，17岁时搬了出去，不久后因一场关于汽车的争吵而与母亲失去了联系。

sentences.en: Shauna had a reputation for being dishonest, with friends recalling she lied shamelessly about having cancer and being pregnant.
sentences.zh: 肖娜素来有不诚实的声誉，朋友们回忆说她曾无耻地谎称自己患有癌症和怀孕。

sentences.en: After she left school, Shauna started studying to become a childcare assistant, but quit the training when she felt pregnant for real.
sentences.zh: 离开学校后，肖娜开始学习成为一名育儿助理，但当她真的怀孕时，她便放弃了培训。

sentences.en: Shauna was thrilled when presented with the opportunity to become Angie's full-time carer, as it would allow her to be paid for work she had been doing previously for free.
sentences.zh: 当有机会成为安吉的全职护工时，肖娜欣喜若狂，因为这让她能够因以前免费所做的工作而获得报酬。

sentences.en: However, Nathan and Shauna's presence wasn't always welcomed at the Goresworthy home.
sentences.zh: 然而，内森和肖娜的出现并不总是受到高斯沃西一家的欢迎。

sentences.en: The couple used the house as a refuge of sorts, eating all the food and often asking for money.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣把这栋房子当成了某种避难所，吃光了所有的食物，还经常索要钱财。

sentences.en: Darren felt the couple took advantage of their hospitality and that Shauna had started to slacken in her caregiving duties for Angie.
sentences.zh: 达伦觉得这对情侣利用了他们的热情好客，而且肖娜对安吉的照顾工作也开始懈怠了。

sentences.en: When Nathan refused to find full-time employment,
sentences.zh: 当内森拒绝寻找全职工作时，

sentences.en: Darren suspected it wasn't fibromyalgia that kept his stepson out of work, but instead laziness and a
sentences.zh: 达伦怀疑阻止他继子工作的不是纤维肌痛，而是懒惰以及

sentences.en: vicious jealous streak that meant he wanted to keep an eye on Shauna at all times.
sentences.zh: 强烈的嫉妒心，这让他想要随时随地监视肖娜。

sentences.en: Darren had disapproved of
sentences.zh: 达伦从一开始就反对

sentences.en: Nathan and Shauna's relationship from its inception.
sentences.zh: 内森和肖娜的恋情。

sentences.en: Nathan met Shauna when he was 21 years old and she was only 14, which wasn't the first time Nathan showed a fixation for underage girls.
sentences.zh: 内森认识肖娜时他21岁，而她只有14岁，这并非内森第一次表现出对未成年女孩的执念。

sentences.en: When Nathan was 19, he drove up to the family home with several young girls in the back of his car who looked no older than 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 内森19岁时，曾开车回到家族住宅，车后座载着几个看起来不超过12岁的年轻女孩。

sentences.en: Darren was furious and ordered Nathan to drive the girls home immediately.
sentences.zh: 达伦大发雷霆，命令内森立刻把这些女孩送回家。

sentences.en: Years later, when Nathan and Shauna had a child together, their critics came to accept their relationship and treat Shauna like family.
sentences.zh: 多年后，当内森和肖娜有了孩子时，批评他们的人也逐渐接受了这段关系，并将肖娜视为家人对待。

sentences.en: But there was still something unpleasant about the two.
sentences.zh: 但这两人身上依然透着某种令人不快的东西。

sentences.en: While Nathan and Shauna usually visited the Goresworthy home almost every day, they had mysteriously kept their distance since Becky's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 虽然内森和肖娜过去几乎每天都会拜访高斯沃西家，但自贝基失踪以来，他们却神秘地保持着距离。

sentences.en: When family members organised to gather together to hand out missing person flyers around town, Nathan and Shauna were nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 当家人们组织起来在镇上分发寻人传单时，内森和肖娜却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Suspicions about Nathan and Shauna continued to rise.
sentences.zh: 对内森和肖娜的怀疑继续加剧。

sentences.en: But up until this point, there was no evidence to directly link them or anyone else to Becky's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 但直到此时，仍没有任何证据能将他们或任何人与贝基的失踪直接联系起来。

sentences.en: It was as though the girl had simply vanished into thin air.
sentences.zh: 这个女孩就像是凭空蒸发了一样。

sentences.en: But then, the forensic test results of the blood sputter and bloody fingerprints found on the doorframe leading into Becky's bedroom came through.
sentences.zh: 然而就在这时，通往贝基卧室门框上发现的血迹喷溅和血手指的法医测试结果出来了。

sentences.en: The blood was confirmed to belong to Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 经证实，这些血迹属于贝基·沃茨。

sentences.en: The fingerprint belonged to her stepbrother, Nathan Matthews.
sentences.zh: 指纹则属于她的继兄内森·马修斯。

sentences.en: On Saturday, February 28, 2015, Nathan Matthews and Shauna Hoare were located at a residential property
sentences.zh: 2015年2月28日星期六，内森·马修斯和肖娜·霍尔在一处住宅物业被找到

sentences.en: in the suburb of South Mead in Bristol's north, the home belonging to Shauna's mother, Lisa.
sentences.zh: 在布里斯托尔北部南米德郊区，绍娜的母亲丽莎的住宅内。

sentences.en: When police entered the house, they found Nathan playing a video game on a wall-mounted television.
sentences.zh: 当警察进入屋内时，他们发现内森正坐在壁挂电视前玩电子游戏。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Rob Dolan swiftly placed Nathan under arrest for the kidnapping of Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 警长罗布·多兰迅速将内森逮捕，罪名是绑架贝基·沃茨。

sentences.en: Dolan immediately told Nathan, I need to undertake an urgent interview with you.
sentences.zh: 多兰立即对内森说：“我需要对你进行一场紧急讯问。”

sentences.en: The basis of this is to find Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 这样做的基础是为了找到贝基·沃茨。

sentences.en: Tell me where Becky is.
sentences.zh: 告诉我贝基在哪里。

sentences.en: Dolan then bombarded Nathan with more questions.
sentences.zh: 接着，多兰向内森抛出了更多问题。

sentences.en: Can you help us with where Becky is?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我们找到贝基在哪吗？

sentences.en: Do you know if Becky is safe?
sentences.zh: 你知道贝基是否安全吗？

sentences.en: Can you help us find out if Becky is safe?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我们查明贝基是否安全吗？

sentences.en: Nathan responded to each question with, no comment.
sentences.zh: 内森对每一个问题的回答都是：“无可奉告。”

sentences.en: Unwilling to assist police, Nathan was immediately taken to Patchway Police Station in Bristol.
sentences.zh: 由于不愿意配合警方，内森随即被带到了布里斯托尔的帕奇韦警察局。

sentences.en: Shauna Hoare was also placed under arrest on suspicion of kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 绍娜·霍尔也被以涉嫌绑架罪逮捕。

sentences.en: When asked if she knew Becky's whereabouts, Shauna responded, no.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否知道贝基的下落时，绍娜回答：“不知道。”

sentences.en: When asked if Becky was safe, Shauna replied, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 当被问及贝基是否安全时，绍娜回答：“我不知道。”

sentences.en: When asked if she could help the police find out if Becky was safe, Shauna stated,
sentences.zh: 当被问及她是否能协助警方查明贝基是否安全时，绍娜表示：

sentences.en: I don't know how to.
sentences.zh: “我不知道该怎么做。”

sentences.en: Upon Nathan and Shauna's arrest, the search to find Becky Watts continued.
sentences.zh: 在内森和绍娜被捕后，搜寻贝基·沃茨的工作仍在继续。

sentences.en: A statement issued by Becky's father Darren and stepmother Angie stated they were aware of the arrests, but finding their daughter remained their highest priority.
sentences.zh: 贝基的父亲达伦和继母安吉发表声明称，他们已知晓逮捕的消息，但找到女儿依然是他们的首要任务。

sentences.en: Darren Galsworthy, quote,
sentences.zh: 达伦·加尔斯沃思，原话：

sentences.en: Rebecca has still not been found.
sentences.zh: “丽贝卡依然没有被找到。”

sentences.en: We continue to hope that she will be found safe and unharmed, but we will prepare ourselves for the worSt.
sentences.zh: “我们依然期盼她能被安全无恙地找到，但我们也做好了最坏的打算。”

sentences.en: Police appealed for witnesses to come forward who may have seen Nathan Matthews' black Vauxhall
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁目击者挺身而出，看是否有人曾在2月19日星期四到2月23日星期一这个关键时间段内，

sentences.en: Zafira car between the critical time period of Thursday, February 19 and Monday, February 23.
sentences.zh: 见过内森·马修斯的黑色沃克斯豪尔赛菲拉汽车。

sentences.en: Detectives arrived to Nathan Matthews' and Shauna Hoare's property on Cotton Mill Lane accompanied by a team of forensic investigators.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在法医调查团队的陪同下，抵达了内森·马修斯和绍娜·霍尔位于科顿米尔巷的住所。

sentences.en: Together, they sifted through the overwhelming clutter, hoping to find any piece of information that could lead them to finding Becky.
sentences.zh: 他们一同在杂乱无章的杂物中仔细搜寻，希望能找到任何能指引他们找到贝基的蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: They uncovered multiple items of interest, including black carpet lining from the boot of Nathan's car, which was found stuffed inside a cooker in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了多件可疑物品，包括从内森汽车后备箱拆下的黑色地毯衬里，它被塞在浴室的一个炊具里。

sentences.en: Two stun guns were sitting on a glass-topped table on the left-hand side of the living room, items which could not be legally possessed without lawful authority.
sentences.zh: 起居室左侧的玻璃面桌上放着两把电击枪，这些是在没有合法授权的情况下非法持有的物品。

sentences.en: The weapons were capable of delivering a shock of over 8,000 volts each without leaving a mark.
sentences.zh: 这些武器每把都能释放出超过8000伏特的电击，且不会留下痕迹。

sentences.en: A promising piece of evidence was found upstairs when traces of blood were detected and immediately sent away for testing against Becky Watt's DNA.
sentences.zh: 在楼上发现了一条有希望的证据，当时检测到了血迹，并立即送去与贝基·沃茨的DNA进行比对测试。

sentences.en: The impeccably clean bathtub in the upstairs bathroom continued to raise suspicions of authorities at the scene, standing out like a sore thumb in the otherwise filthy flat.
sentences.zh: 楼上浴室里那间一尘不染的浴缸继续引起现场当局的怀疑，在原本肮脏的公寓里显得格格不入。

sentences.en: Upon entering the bathroom, the tub was positioned against the right-side wall, glistening white and empty.
sentences.zh: 一进浴室，浴缸就靠右侧墙壁放置，洁白闪亮且空空如也。

sentences.en: Yet, the rest of the room was crammed with more of the same junk that filled the rest of the house, including a cooker and microwave,
sentences.zh: 然而，房间的其他地方塞满了跟屋里其他地方一样的垃圾，包括一个炊具和微波炉，

sentences.en: with bags, clothes, dirty dishes and rubbish piled on top.
sentences.zh: 上面堆满了包、衣服、脏盘子和垃圾。

sentences.en: Extensive chemical analysis of the tub, waste pipes, wall tiles, blinds and door failed to reveal any trace of Becky Watt's DNA.
sentences.zh: 对浴缸、排水管、墙砖、百叶窗和门进行的广泛化学分析未能显示出任何贝基·沃茨的DNA痕迹。

sentences.en: It was clear the tub and surrounding tiles had recently been scrubbed using harsh disinfectants, with drain cleaner poured down the pipes.
sentences.zh: 很显然，浴缸和周边的瓷砖最近刚用强力消毒剂擦洗过，管道里还倒了管道疏通剂。

sentences.en: Hidden inside a cupboard, investigators found several crumpled receipts dated Friday, February 20.
sentences.zh: 调查人员藏在一个橱柜里，发现了数张揉皱的收据，日期是2月20日星期五。

sentences.en: The day after, Becky allegedly left her home and disappeared.
sentences.zh: 也就是贝基据称离开家并失踪的第二天。

sentences.en: One receipt from local home improvement retail store B&Q totaled £88 and listed the sale of four iteMs.
sentences.zh: 其中一张来自本地家居装饰零售店百安居的收据总计88英镑，上面列出了四件商品的销售记录。

sentences.en: Goggles, face masks, gloves and a circular saw.
sentences.zh: 护目镜、面罩、手套和一把圆锯。

sentences.en: CCTV footage obtained from B&Q showed Nathan Matthews enter the store alone at around 12.50pm, dressed completely in black.
sentences.zh: 从百安居获取的闭路电视监控录像显示，内森·马修斯于下午1点50分左右独自进入商店，一身全黑打扮。

sentences.en: He made his way to the power tool aisle where he casually paced in front of a shelf, inspecting several items, before eventually settling on a McAllister brand circular saw.
sentences.zh: 他径直走向电动工具过道，在货架前随意踱步，检查了几件商品，最后决定买下一把麦克阿利斯特品牌的圆锯。

sentences.en: When Nathan went to purchase the item, it scanned at a higher cost than he anticipated, and he queried the price with the shop assistant.
sentences.zh: 当内森去购买这件商品时，它的扫描价格比他预期的要高，于是他向店员询问了价格。

sentences.en: Remarking that he needed the power saw that day, Nathan disregarded the expense, paid for the item in full, and left.
sentences.zh: 内森表示他当天必须用这把电锯，于是不再计较费用，全额付款后离开了。

sentences.en: A second receipt, dated Saturday, February 21, the day after the circular saw was purchased, came from a local Asda supermarket, and listed various items totaling £98,
sentences.zh: 第二张收据日期为2月21日星期六，也就是购买圆锯的第二天，来自当地的阿斯达超市，上面列出了总计98英镑的各种商品，

sentences.en: including rubber gloves, bleach, and three rolls of cling film.
sentences.zh: 包括橡胶手套、漂白剂和三卷保鲜膜。

sentences.en: CCTV footage recovered from the supermarket showed Nathan making the purchase.
sentences.zh: 从超市调取的监控录像显示内森进行了这笔购买。

sentences.en: But he wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 但他并非独自一人。

sentences.en: This time, he was accompanied by Shauna.
sentences.zh: 这一次，陪伴他的是绍娜。

sentences.en: The couple were caught on CCTV again the next day, Sunday February 22, this time entering discount retail chain 99P Store,
sentences.zh: 这对情侣第二天（2月22日星期日）再次被监控拍到，这次他们进入了折扣零售连锁店99P商店，

sentences.en: where they purchased eight reinforced rubbish bags, duct tape, various cleaning products, and a heavy-duty sponge.
sentences.zh: 在那里他们购买了八个加厚垃圾袋、管道胶带、各种清洁产品和一个重型海绵。

sentences.en: After these discoveries were made, police informed Nathan Matthews and Shauna Hoare they were now being held under arrest on suspicion of the murder of Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 在这些发现曝光后，警方通知内森·马修斯和绍娜·霍尔，他们现在因涉嫌谋杀贝基·沃茨而被拘留。

sentences.en: Despite efforts to encourage the pair to start talking, they both remained tight-lipped.
sentences.zh: 尽管努力鼓励两人开口，但他们俩都守口如瓶。

sentences.en: Investigators hinted they had uncovered some important evidence in the couple's home, hoping to pressure the accused into talking.
sentences.zh: 调查人员暗示他们在这对情侣的家中发现了一些重要证据，希望能以此向被告施压使其开口。

sentences.en: When Nathan was informed that traces of blood had been found in his home, he appeared rattled.
sentences.zh: 当内森被告知在他家中发现了血迹时，他显得有些慌乱。

sentences.en: He immediately asked if it had been found upstairs, and investigators confirmed it had.
sentences.zh: 他立即询问是否是在楼上发现的，调查人员予以确认。

sentences.en: Tests later revealed this blood was unrelated to the Becky Watts case, but the mere mention of it caused an immediate change in Nathan Matthews' demeanour.
sentences.zh: 后来的测试表明这些血迹与贝基·沃茨案无关，但仅仅是提及此事就让内森·马修斯的神态发生了立刻的改变。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Inspector Richard O'Cone,
sentences.zh: 高级督察理查德·奥康恩：

sentences.en: I think it probably felt like he was battling against a rising tide, and actually, you could feel the evidence starting to come on top.
sentences.zh: “我想这可能让他感觉像是在逆流而上，事实上，你能感觉到证据开始占据上风。”

sentences.en: It was starting to weigh quite heavily.
sentences.zh: “开始变得相当沉重。”

sentences.en: Eventually, the pressure mounted until it finally became too much to bear,
sentences.zh: 最终，压力不断累积，直到变得再也无法承受，

sentences.en: and Nathan Matthews broke.
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯崩溃了。

sentences.en: On March 2, 2015, 12 days after Becky's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 2015年3月2日，在贝基失踪12天后，

sentences.en: Nathan Matthews dictated a written statement in the presence of his lawyer, detailing his version of the events that took place inside the Galsworthy home
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯在他的律师在场的情况下口述了一份书面声明，详细讲述了他对2015年2月19日星期四

sentences.en: on Thursday, February 19, 2015.
sentences.zh: 发生在加尔斯沃思家里的事件的看法。

sentences.en: Nathan Matthews, quote,
sentences.zh: 内森·马修斯，原话：

sentences.en: I, Nathan Charles Matthews, date of birth, 9th of January, 1987, accept that I am responsible for the death of Rebecca Watts.
sentences.zh: “我，内森·查尔斯·马修斯，出生日期：1987年1月9日，承认我对丽贝卡·沃茨的死负有责任。”

sentences.en: On the 19th of February, 2015,
I attended 18 Crown Hill with my girlfriend, Shauna Hoare.
sentences.zh: “我和女友绍娜·霍尔一起去了克朗山18号。”

sentences.en: 18 Crown Hill is where my mother lives with Darren Galsworthy.
sentences.zh: “克朗山18号是我母亲和达伦·加尔斯沃思住的地方。”

sentences.en: Rebecca Watts also lived there.
sentences.zh: “丽贝卡·沃茨也住在那里。”

sentences.en: Shauna is my mother's registered carer, so we regularly go to the house to help with housework and other help my mother needs.
sentences.zh: “绍娜是我母亲注册的护工，所以我们经常去那栋房子帮忙做家务以及提供我母亲需要的其他帮助。”

sentences.en: Although we usually went there on Monday, Wednesdays and Fridays, we did also go there on other days.
sentences.zh: “虽然我们通常在周一、周三和周五去那里，但我们确实也在其他日子去过。”

sentences.en: On Thursday, 19th February, part of the reason for going around was to return a tin to my grandmother.
sentences.zh: “在2月19日星期四，过去的部分原因是为了把一个罐子还给我祖母。”

sentences.en: My grandmother was due to take my mother to a medical appointment and bring her back.
sentences.zh: “我祖母本该带我母亲去预约看病并接她回来。”

sentences.en: In my car, I had a large bag, a stun device, handcuffs, tape, and mask.
sentences.zh: “我的车里有一个大袋子、一个电击装置、手铐、胶带和面罩。”

sentences.en: I had developed an idea to scare Rebecca by kidnapping her.
sentences.zh: “我当时产生了一个通过绑架丽贝卡来吓唬她的想法。”

sentences.en: I wanted to kidnap her to teach her a lesson.
sentences.zh: “我想绑架她是想给她点颜色看看。”

sentences.en: I believed that she was selfish and her behaviour towards my mother was a risk to her health.
sentences.zh: “我认为她很自私，她对我母亲的态度对她的健康构成了威胁。”

sentences.en: When we got to 18 Crown Hill, we let ourselves in with a key my mother had left in the recycling box.
sentences.zh: “当我们到达克朗山18号时，我们用我母亲留在回收箱里的钥匙自己开了门。”

sentences.en: Upon entering the property, we all went to the front room.
sentences.zh: “进入屋内后，我们都去了前厅。”

sentences.en: A few minutes after arriving, Shauna said she wanted a cigarette and went into the garden.
sentences.zh: “到达几分钟后，绍娜说她想抽根烟，就去了花园。”

sentences.en: I went to the boot of my car and took out a bag which contained the other iteMs.
sentences.zh: “我走到汽车后备箱，拿出一个装有其他物品的袋子。”

sentences.en: I took everything upstairs to the landing.
sentences.zh: “我把所有东西都拿到楼上的平台上。”

sentences.en: I think I then took the items out of the bag before knocking on Rebecca's door.
sentences.zh: “我想我随后把东西从袋子里拿了出来，然后敲了丽贝卡的房门。”

sentences.en: She replied what or hello, and I said, can I see you a minute or similar words.
sentences.zh: “她回答‘什么’或‘喂’，我说，‘我能见你一分钟吗’或类似的话。”

sentences.en: Rebecca then opened the door.
sentences.zh: “然后丽贝卡开了门。”

sentences.en: I'm wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: “我戴着面罩。”

sentences.en: I cannot be sure in which order things happened immediately after she came to the door, but I used the items I had to subdue Rebecca.
sentences.zh: “我无法确定她在开门后立即发生了什么事情的顺序，但我用我带的物品制服了丽贝卡。”

sentences.en: During a short struggle, my mask slipped and Rebecca was able to see my face.
sentences.zh: “在一番短暂的挣扎中，我的面罩滑落了，丽贝卡得以看到我的脸。”

sentences.en: This caused me to panic, and I strangled her when she was partially in the bag.
sentences.zh: “这让我陷入恐慌，当她半个身子在袋子里时，我勒死了她。”

sentences.en: I collected the items I had used, put them and Rebecca into the bag, and zipped up the bag.
sentences.zh: “我收好我用过的物品，把它们和丽贝卡一起放进袋子里，并拉上了拉链。”

sentences.en: I also took her phone, tablet, and a laptop, together with shoes, some clothes, and a duvet cover from the spare room in a separate bag.
sentences.zh: “我还拿了她的手机、平板电脑和一台笔记本电脑，以及一个独立袋子里备用房间的鞋子、一些衣服和羽绒被套。”

sentences.en: I took everything downstairs and put it into the boot of my car.
sentences.zh: “我把所有东西都拿到楼下，放进了汽车的后备箱。”

sentences.en: Back in the house, I waited to hear Shauna, then slammed the front door shut.
sentences.zh: “回到屋里后，我等着听见绍娜的声音，然后‘砰’的一声关上了前门。”

sentences.en: Before going to the front room, I checked that Shauna was not in that room.
sentences.zh: “在去前厅之前，我确认了绍娜不在那个房间里。”

sentences.en: The rest of the day at the house goes as it would normally if we were there.
sentences.zh: “那天在屋里的其余时间就像我们平常在那儿时一样正常进行。”

sentences.en: We leave at about 7pm.
sentences.zh: “我们在晚上7点左右离开。”

sentences.en: The rest of the evening passed as usual, but I could not remember exactly what we did.
sentences.zh: “那天晚上的其余时间照常度过，但我记不清我们具体做了什么。”

sentences.en: After Shauna went to bed and sleep, I waited a while and went out to the car and brought the bags into the house.
sentences.zh: “在绍娜上床睡觉后，我等了一会儿，出去走到车前，把袋子拿进了屋里。”

sentences.en: The following day, we went back to 18 Crown Hill and I tried to behave as normal.
sentences.zh: “第二天，我们回到了克朗山18号，我尽量表现得像往常一样。”

sentences.en: I tried to behave as normal as I could.
sentences.zh: “我尽量表现得和往常一样自然。”

sentences.en: When we returned to 14 Cotton Mill Lane, I again waited for Shauna to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: “当我们回到科顿米尔巷14号时，我再次等绍娜入睡。”

sentences.en: This time, I collected the bag with Rebecca's body and placed it in the bath.
sentences.zh: “这一次，我拿了装有丽贝卡遗体的袋子，把它放进了浴缸里。”

sentences.en: In order to stop Shauna using the bathroom the following morning, I poured a drain cleaner down the toilet so I could tell Shauna it was blocked again.
sentences.zh: “为了阻止绍娜第二天早上使用浴室，我在马桶里倒了管道疏通剂，这样我就可以告诉绍娜马桶又堵了。”

sentences.en: The toilet would often get blocked, and when that happened, I knew Shauna would not go into the bathroom.
sentences.zh: “马桶经常会堵塞，当发生这种情况时，我知道绍娜是不会去浴室的。”

sentences.en: I also locked the door.
sentences.zh: “我还把门锁上了。”

sentences.en: My memory of the days that followed is not perfect, so I'm not sure which day I returned to 14 Cotton Mill Lane having left Shauna at my mother's, but I think it was the Saturday.
sentences.zh: “我对接下来几天的事情记忆并不完美，所以我不太确定我是哪天把绍娜留在母亲那里后回到了科顿米尔巷14号，但我想那是周六。”

sentences.en: When I got back to 14 Cotton Mill Lane, I tried to dispose of the body by cutting it up with a circular saw.
sentences.zh: “当我回到科顿米尔巷14号时，我试图用一把圆锯将尸体切碎来处理掉。”

sentences.en: Initially, I wrapped up the body parts and took them back downstairs and hid them.
sentences.zh: “最初，我把尸块包起来，把它们带回楼下藏了起来。”

sentences.en: I'm not sure how many days later, but on another day, I took the body, the saw, and other items to 9 Barton Court, Barton Hill, and placed them in a garden shed.
sentences.zh: “我不确定是多少天后，但在另一天，我把尸体、锯子和其他物品带到了巴顿山巴顿法院9号，把它们放在了一个花园杂物棚里。”

sentences.en: I took them to this address with two other people.
sentences.zh: “我和另外两个人把它们带到了这个地址。”

sentences.en: I did not tell them what was in the bags and box, and I said I would collect them in a few days.
sentences.zh: “我没有告诉他们袋子和箱子里装的是什么，我说过几天我会来取。”

sentences.en: Both of these people are men, but I do not want to name them.
sentences.zh: “这两个人都是男性，但我不想说出他们的名字。”

sentences.en: I have chosen to give my account by means of a written statement because I believe I have mental health and learning difficulties that make it difficult for me to say it out loud.
sentences.zh: “我选择通过一份书面声明来陈述我的经历，因为我认为我有心理健康和学习障碍，这使得我很难大声说出来。”

sentences.en: Also, I find it difficult to express the detail in this account in spoken words.
sentences.zh: “此外，我发现很难用口头语言表达这份陈述中的细节。”

sentences.en: I would like to add that my denials to date have been motivated in part by a wish to avoid the pain and disappointment these admissions would cause to my partner and family.
sentences.zh: “我想补充的是，我至今为止的否认，部分动机是希望避免这些供述会给我的伴侣和家人带来痛苦和失望。”

sentences.en: This statement was written by my solicitor, but it has been read by me, and I can confirm that it is an accurate account.
sentences.zh: “这份声明是由我的律师撰写的，但它已经由我阅读过，我可以确认这是一份准确的陈述。”

sentences.en: Shauna did not know anything about my causing the death of Rebecca, or my attempt to dispose of and hide the body.
sentences.zh: “绍娜对导致丽贝卡死亡一事，以及我试图处理并藏匿尸体的行为一无所知。”

sentences.en: Had she known, she would have reported me to the police.
sentences.zh: “如果她知道了，她会向警方举报我。”

sentences.en: Apart from this statement, I will exercise my right to silence.
sentences.zh: “除了这份声明，我将行使我的沉默权。”

sentences.en: Following his confession, Nathan Matthews was formally charged with the murder of his stepsister,
sentences.zh: 在供认之后，内森·马修斯被正式指控谋杀他的继妹，

sentences.en: Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 贝基·沃茨。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目马上回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: After Nathan confessed, police attended Nine Barton Court in Barton Hill, where Nathan stated he had taken Becky's body.
sentences.zh: 在内森坦白后，警方前往了巴顿山的巴顿法院9号，内森曾称他把贝基的遗体带到了那里。

sentences.en: Nine Barton Court is a double-storey, red-brick terrace home on the western edge of Bristol's Netham Park.
sentences.zh: 巴顿法院9号是位于布里斯托尔内瑟姆公园西缘的一栋双层红砖排屋。

sentences.en: Police were greeted by 29-year-old man Donovan Demetrius, who revealed the property was owned by his twin brother, Carl.
sentences.zh: 警方受到了29岁男子多诺万·德米特里乌斯的迎接，他透露这处房产属于他的双胞胎兄弟卡尔。

sentences.en: He permitted officers' entry, with a cursory search of the interior confirming no one else was present.
sentences.zh: 他允许警官进入，对内部进行的大致搜查确认没有其他人在场。

sentences.en: Glass patio doors at the rear of the home led out to a small, concrete courtyard encased in a tall timber fence.
sentences.zh: 房屋后部的玻璃天井门通向一个被高大木栅栏包围的小型混凝土庭院。

sentences.en: The courtyard was sparse, containing nothing but a barbecue.
sentences.zh: 庭院空空如也，除了一个烧烤架外别无他物。

sentences.en: Just as Nathan Matthews had described in his confession, a garden shed was situated at the rear of the property.
sentences.zh: 正如内森·马修斯在他的供词中所描述的那样，房产后方有一个花园杂物棚。

sentences.en: A large, square timber structure, stocked full of belongings.
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的、正方形的木质结构，里面塞满了物品。

sentences.en: Its windows covered.
sentences.zh: 它的窗户被遮盖着。

sentences.en: Upon entering the shed, investigators noticed several black garbage bags, a blue plastic box, a rucksack, and four suitcases piled on top of one another against the wall.
sentences.zh: 进入杂物棚后，调查人员注意到靠墙堆叠着几个黑色垃圾袋、一个蓝色塑料箱、一个背包和四个手提箱。

sentences.en: The largest suitcase closest to the shed door was packed with a number of tightly wrapped parcels, covered in cling film and plastic bags.
sentences.zh: 最靠近杂物棚门的最大手提箱里装满了许多紧紧包裹的包裹，外面裹着保鲜膜和塑料袋。

sentences.en: After opening a package the size of a rugby ball and unwrapping the multiple layers of cling film that
sentences.zh: 在打开一个橄榄球大小的包裹并解开包裹它的多层保鲜膜后，

sentences.en: bound it together, investigators were horrified to discover what it contained.
sentences.zh: 调查人员惊恐地发现里面装的是什么。

sentences.en: It was a human right hand.
sentences.zh: 那是一只人类的右手。

sentences.en: The fist clenched and severed at the wriSt.
sentences.zh: 拳头紧握，在手腕处被切断。

sentences.en: The fingernails varnished in red nail polish.
sentences.zh: 指甲涂着红色的指甲油。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Inspector Richard Acone,
sentences.zh: 高级督察理查德·阿康恩：

sentences.zh: 其余手提箱里的东西露出了更多被肢解的身体部位。

sentences.en: The rucksack contained a twelve and a half centimetre knife contaminated with blood and hair,
sentences.zh: 背包里有一把沾有血迹和头发的十二点五厘米长的刀，

sentences.en: along with a pair of scissors, two screwdrivers, handcuffs, blood-stained safety goggles, two face masks, a pink-spotted shower curtain, and two bottles of drain cleaner.
sentences.zh: 还有一把剪刀、两把螺丝刀、手铐、沾有血迹的安全护目镜、两个面罩、一条带粉红斑点的浴帘以及两瓶管道疏通剂。

sentences.en: Inside a different suitcase was a Macallister brand circular saw matted with blood and hair.
sentences.zh: 在另一个手提箱里是一把沾满血迹和头发的麦卡利斯特牌圆锯。

sentences.en: A laptop, tablet, and pieces of a broken iPhone were found inside plastic shopping bags that were knotted closed.
sentences.zh: 一个笔记本电脑、平板电脑和一部碎iPhone的碎片被放在打了结的塑料购物袋里。

sentences.en: A black carrier bag contained makeup, two pairs of women's shoes, black ankle boots and pink slippers, along with other items of women's clothing.
sentences.zh: 一个黑色手提袋里装有化妆品、两双女鞋、黑色短靴和粉色拖鞋，以及其他女式服装。

sentences.en: A faux leather jacket, a blue checkered shirt, and a blue puffer-style jacket.
sentences.zh: 一件人造皮革夹克、一件蓝色格子衬衫和一件蓝色羽绒服。

sentences.en: The human remains were transported to a nearby mortuary, where a forensic pathologist had the difficult task of performing a post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 人类遗骸被运送到附近的停尸房，法医病理学家在那里承担了进行尸检的艰难任务。

sentences.en: The body parts had been wrapped so tightly that the plastic had a preserving effect, and some of the remains had been packed with kitchen salt and kitty litter,
sentences.zh: 尸体被裹得如此紧密，以至于塑料起到了防腐作用，部分遗骸中还塞满了食盐和猫砂，

sentences.zh: 这进一步起到了防腐作用。

sentences.en: DNA extracted from the body was compared to samples previously taken from Becky Watt's toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 从尸体上提取的DNA与此前从贝基·沃茨的牙刷中采集的样本进行了比对。

sentences.en: The remains were confirmed to belong to the 16-year-old, with the blood and hair on the circular saw and weapons also established to be Becky's.
sentences.zh: 经证实，这些遗骸属于这名16岁少女，圆锯和凶器上的血迹和毛发也被证实属于贝基。

sentences.en: The other possessions found with her remains, including the technology devices, makeup, and clothing, also belonged to the teen.
sentences.zh: 在她遗骸旁发现的其他物品，包括电子设备、化妆品和衣物，也属于这名少女。

sentences.en: According to the pathologist's report, the likely cause of Becky Watt's death was suffocation.
sentences.zh: 根据病理学家报告，贝基·沃茨的死因极可能是窒息。

sentences.en: Injuries to her face were consistent with this finding, as it appeared someone had held their hand over her nose and mouth with considerable force.
sentences.zh: 她脸部的伤势与这一发现相符，因为看起来有人曾用力捂住她的鼻子和嘴巴。

sentences.en: This piece of information contradicted Nathan Matthew's confession, in which he claimed to have strangled Becky to death.
sentences.zh: 这一信息与内森·马修斯的供词相矛盾，他此前声称自己将贝基勒死。

sentences.en: This discrepancy indicated his version of events were not entirely truthful.
sentences.zh: 这一出入表明他的供述并非完全属实。

sentences.en: Becky Watt sustained more than 40 defensive wounds across her body, indicating she had put up a fight during the attack.
sentences.zh: 贝基·沃茨全身遭受了40多处防御性伤痕，表明她在袭击中进行了反抗。

sentences.en: There were 15 stab wounds inflicted post-mortem, and an attempt had also been made to drain her body of fluid.
sentences.zh: 尸体上还有15处死后造成的刺伤，并且还曾试图排干体液。

sentences.en: There were no signs of sexual injury.
sentences.zh: 没有性侵伤痕的迹象。

sentences.en: In his confession, Nathan Matthews refused to name the two men he claimed helped him move the luggage containing Becky's remains and belongings to the
sentences.zh: 在供词中，内森·马修斯拒绝说出那两名男子的名字，他声称这两人帮他把装有贝基遗骸和物品的行李搬到了

sentences.en: garden shed at the rear of Nine Barton Court.
sentences.zh: 位于九号巴顿阁后方的花园小屋里。

sentences.en: However, it didn't take long for investigators to identify Nathan's accomplices.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查人员并没有花太长时间就查明了内森的同伙。

sentences.en: On the night of Monday, February 23, 2015, four days after Becky Watts was murdered, 29-year-old Carl Demetrius was at his workplace situated in the town of Filton,
sentences.zh: 2015年2月23日星期一晚上，即贝基·沃茨遇害四天后，29岁的卡尔·德米特里厄斯正在位于费尔顿镇的工作岗位上，

sentences.en: five miles north of Bristol's city centre.
sentences.zh: 该镇位于布里斯托尔市中心以北五英里处。

sentences.zh: 午夜前不久，卡尔接到了一通电话，

sentences.zh: 打电话的是内森·马修斯，他需要运送和存放一些物品。

sentences.en: Desperate for help, Nathan was willing to pay 10,000 pounds to get the job done.
sentences.zh: 内森急需帮助，愿意支付1万英镑来完成这项工作。

sentences.en: After the call, Carl approached 23-year-old colleague James
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，卡尔找到23岁的同事詹姆斯·

sentences.en: Island and offered him half of the job's windfall in exchange for his assistance.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰，并提出分给他一半的酬劳以换取他的协助。

sentences.en: James agreed, as he was always keen to make some quick cash.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯同意了，因为他一直渴望快点赚点外快。

sentences.en: At 12.29am, the pair left work in James's Ford Fiesta and drove to a residential property in Southmead where they picked up Nathan Matthews and Shauna Hoare.
sentences.zh: 凌晨12点29分，两人驾驶詹姆斯的福特嘉年华离开工作地点，驶向绍斯米德的一处住宅，在那里接上了内森·马修斯和肖娜·霍尔。

sentences.en: James Island had never met the couple before and had little interaction with them during the drive other than asking for directions to their home.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·伊斯兰此前从未见过这对情侣，在车程中除了解问去他们家的路线外，与他们几乎没有交流。

sentences.en: When the group arrived at Cotton Mill Lane, James was left alone in the car while the others got out.
sentences.zh: 当一行人到达棉磨巷时，詹姆斯被单独留在车里，其他人则下了车。

sentences.en: Carl and Nathan had a discussion before telling James to go back to work and exchange his car for a van.
sentences.zh: 卡尔和内森商量了一番，然后叫詹姆斯回单位换一辆面包车来。

sentences.en: James did as requested, obtaining the white work van and returning to Nathan's house at around 1.30am.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯照办了，开着那辆白色的工作面包车于凌晨1点30分左右回到了内森家。

sentences.en: The items Nathan wanted to transport to Carl's house included several heavy suitcases, black garbage bags and a blue plastic box.
sentences.zh: 内森想要运到卡尔家的物品包括几个沉重的手提箱、黑色垃圾袋和一个蓝色塑料箱。

sentences.en: Nathan wouldn't reveal what they contained and gave the others strict instructions not to look inside.
sentences.zh: 内森不肯透露里面装的是什么，并严厉指示其他人不准打开查看。

sentences.en: It took the three men approximately
sentences.zh: 三名男子大约花了

sentences.en: 25 minutes to load the items into the van.
sentences.zh: 25分钟才把这些物品装上面包车。

sentences.en: Carl and James initially suspected the heavy bags contained stolen electrical goods or something similar, but upon feeling that the bags held something soft,
sentences.zh: 卡尔和詹姆斯起初怀疑这些沉重的袋子里装着偷来的电器或类似的东西，但当摸到袋子里有柔软的东西时，

sentences.en: they assumed they were filled with drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们猜想里面装的是毒品。

sentences.en: As they made the short drive to Carl's Barton Court property, the van's movements were recorded on local CCTV traffic cameras.
sentences.zh: 在短途开往卡尔位于巴顿阁的住所时，面包车的行踪被当地的闭路电视交通摄像头记录了下来。

sentences.en: When the trio arrived to 9 Barton Court, it took them two trips to load the bags into the kitchen before relocating them to the garden shed at the rear of the property.
sentences.zh: 当三人抵达巴顿阁9号时，他们分两趟把袋子搬进厨房，然后转移到房产后方的花园小屋里。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Carl and James returned to work, where they were overheard gloating about the money they had just made.
sentences.zh: 之后，卡尔和詹姆斯返回工作岗位，在那里听到他们得意洋洋地谈论刚赚到的钱。

sentences.en: The next day, Nathan returned to Carl's house with a rucksack, placing it in the shed with his other belongings.
sentences.zh: 第二天，内森带着一个背包回到卡尔家，把它和他的其他物品一起放进了小屋里。

sentences.en: He told Carl he would return within a few days to collect the goods.
sentences.zh: 他告诉卡尔，他会在几天内回来取走这些东西。

sentences.en: A week after helping Nathan Matthews move the luggage, Carl and James were at work when a colleague noted the pair were acting oddly and were seen having a secretive conversation.
sentences.zh: 在帮内森·马修斯搬运行李一周后，卡尔和詹姆斯正在上班，一名同事注意到两人举止异常，还在进行神神秘秘的交谈。

sentences.en: The very next day, Carl Demetrius and James Ireland were arrested in relation to the murder of Becky Watts, charged with assisting an offender.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，卡尔·德米特里厄斯和詹姆斯·爱尔兰因涉嫌谋杀贝基·沃茨被捕，罪名是协助犯罪分子。

sentences.en: Text messages sent between Carl and his 23-year-old girlfriend, Jayden Parsons, confirmed that she too knew about the job Nathan Matthews had hired her boyfriend to complete.
sentences.zh: 卡尔与他23岁的女朋友杰登·帕森斯之间发送的手机短信证实，她也知道内森·马修斯雇佣她男友完成的这项工作。

sentences.en: Jayden encouraged Carl to store the items for Nathan, saying they could use the subsequent payment for a house deposit.
sentences.zh: 杰登鼓励卡尔为内森存放这些物品，称他们可以用随后的酬金来付买房首付。

sentences.en: Like Carl and James, Jayden assumed the bags contained something illegal, but maintained having absolutely no knowledge of the true contents.
sentences.zh: 和卡尔与詹姆斯一样，杰登猜测袋子里装着非法物品，但坚称自己对真实内容毫不知情。

sentences.en: Due to having knowledge of the act, Jayden Parsons was also arrested for assisting an offender, as was Carl's twin

sentences.zh: 2月24日上班时，这个人看起来明显很疲惫，而且格外沉默寡言。

sentences.en: Donovan told his manager he didn't get much sleep the night before, because he was helping his brother with something.
sentences.zh: 多诺万告诉经理，他前一晚没睡好，因为他在帮他兄弟弄点事情。

sentences.en: Despite Nathan Matthews' adamant claims that he acted alone in committing Becky's murder, investigators were convinced Shauna Hoare played a part.
sentences.zh: 尽管内森·马修斯坚称谋杀贝基是他一人所为，但调查人员确信肖娜·霍尔也参与其中。

sentences.en: Shauna insisted she was completely oblivious to the fact that Nathan killed Becky.
sentences.zh: 肖娜坚称自己对内森杀害贝基一事完全一无所知。

sentences.en: Her story hadn't changed.
sentences.zh: 她的说法一直没有改变。

sentences.en: She was in the backyard smoking a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 她当时在后院抽烟。

sentences.en: She maintained having no idea that Becky's body was in the boot of Nathan's car as the couple drove home
sentences.zh: 她坚称当晚开车回家时，根本不知道贝基的尸体就在内森的车后备箱里，

sentences.en: that night, or that Nathan had dismembered Becky's body in their upstairs bathroom.
sentences.zh: 也不知道内森在楼上浴室里分尸了贝基。

sentences.en: Shauna claimed to have gone to bed early on the night that Becky's body parts were moved to Barton Court.
sentences.zh: 肖娜声称在贝基的尸体部位被运往巴顿阁的那天晚上，她很早就上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: However, she did recall Nathan talking to friends by a car outside that night.
sentences.zh: 不过，她确实记起当晚内森在外面车旁和朋友交谈过。

sentences.en: According to Shauna, Nathan complained about Becky constantly, but had never done anything to suggest he wanted to hurt her.

sentences.en: He had a violent and aggressive temperament at times, and could get wound up very quickly, but only ever took his frustrations out on Shauna.

sentences.en: To solidify his case, prosecution lawyer William Mousley presented Nathan's computer, on which police uncovered evidence that Nathan accessed pornography nearly every day.
sentences.zh: 为了坐实他的论点，主控检察官威廉·莫斯利出示了南森的电脑，警方在上面发现了南森几乎每天都访问色情网站的证据。

sentences.zh: 莫斯利辩称，这一场景与南森对贝姬的袭击有着惊人的相似之处，这表明他是以该视频作为灵感的。

sentences.zh: 两人之间的私信清楚地表明他对她产生了性趣。

sentences.zh: 南森的祖母作证说，他的心理健康在过去两年里急剧恶化，在此期间他对贝姬的厌恶也有所增加。

sentences.en: When it came to Shauna Hoare, the prosecution presented a video which was accessed on Shauna's mobile phone on the day of Becky's murder.
sentences.zh: 至于肖娜·霍尔，控方出示了一段在贝姬遇害当天从肖娜手机上浏览过的视频。

sentences.en: The video, which was searched for on YouTube, was a parody of a Disney song from the popular movie Frozen, titled, Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
sentences.zh: 该视频是通过YouTube搜索的，是热门电影《冰雪奇缘》中一首迪士尼歌曲的恶搞版，名为《你想不想堆雪人？》

sentences.zh: 《你想不想藏一具尸体？》

sentences.en: According to Shauna, the fact that she watched the video on the day
sentences.zh: 据肖娜说，她在

sentences.zh: 贝姬遇害当天观看这段视频纯属巧合。

sentences.en: She claimed to have only accessed it to make Nathan laugh, insisting she had no idea he had just killed Becky.
sentences.zh: 她声称自己访问该视频只是为了逗南森笑，坚称自己根本不知道他刚杀害了贝姬。

sentences.en: In his closing statements, prosecution lawyer
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，主控检察官

sentences.en: William Mousley described Shauna's claim of ignorance to Nathan's crimes as a ridiculous concept.
sentences.zh: 威廉·莫斯利将肖娜对自己对南森罪行一无所知的说法形容为一个荒谬绝伦的概念。

sentences.en: She was in the house when Becky was killed, in the car carrying Becky's body, and at home when Becky's body was in her bathtub.
sentences.zh: 贝姬被杀时她在屋里，装着贝姬尸体的车里有她，家里有贝姬尸体时她也在家。

sentences.en: Mousley said Shauna displayed a cool, cold, collected facade that in no way made her
sentences.zh: 莫斯利说，肖娜表现出一种冷静、冷酷、镇定的外表，这完全

sentences.zh: 让她看起来不像一个迷路的小女孩。在她的警方讯问录像中，尽管情况严重，她依然兴高采烈地回答有关贝姬

sentences.en: welfare cheerfully, sometimes giggling, despite the seriousness of the situation.
sentences.zh: 福利的问题，有时甚至咯咯发笑。

sentences.en: Shauna was compared to Lady Macbeth, the mastermind in Shakespeare's famous play, who provokes her husband to commit murder for her own personal gain.
sentences.zh: 肖娜被拿来与麦克白夫人作比较，后者莎士比亚名剧中的主谋，为了自己的私利唆使丈夫去谋杀。

sentences.en: Mousley said the famous line from Macbeth applied to Shauna, be like an innocent flower, but a serpent beneath.
sentences.zh: 莫斯利说，麦克白的名言适用于肖娜：举止要像纯洁的花朵，但在花朵下却要藏着毒蛇。

sentences.en: As for Nathan Matthews,
sentences.zh: 至于南森·马修斯，

sentences.en: Mousley pointed out that the confessed killer lied repeatedly, arguing Nathan's actions were full of hatred.
sentences.zh: 莫斯利指出，这个供认不讳的杀人犯一再撒谎，并辩称南森的行为充满了仇恨。

sentences.en: Becky's death was not an accident or abduction gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 贝姬的死并非意外，也不是绑架出了岔子。

sentences.en: It was cold-blooded murder.
sentences.zh: 这是一场冷血的谋杀。

sentences.en: The trial concluded on November 11, 2015, and the jury retired to consider five weeks worth of evidence to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 审判于2015年11月11日结束，陪审团退席商议长达五周的证据以达成裁决。

sentences.en: After just over three hours of deliberation, the jury declared Nathan Matthews guilty of the murder of Becky Watts.
sentences.zh: 经过三个多小时的审议，陪审团裁定南森·马修斯谋杀贝姬·沃茨罪名成立。

sentences.en: Shauna Hoare was found not guilty of murder, but guilty of the lesser charge of manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 肖娜·霍尔谋杀罪名不成立，但较轻的过失杀人罪名成立。

sentences.en: Sentencing occurred on November 13, 2015, during which Becky Watts' parents delivered heart-wrenching victim impact statements, revealing how deeply loved their daughter had been
sentences.zh: 宣判于2015年11月13日进行，期间贝姬·沃茨的父母发表了痛彻心扉的受害者影响陈述，透露了他们的女儿曾被多么深爱

sentences.en: and how tragically her murder had changed their lives.
sentences.zh: 以及她的谋杀给他们的生活带来了多么悲惨的改变。

sentences.en: Nathan bent forward, keeping his head down during their statements, while Shauna remained seated upright, staring straight ahead.
sentences.zh: 在宣读声明期间，南森向前弯着身子，一直低着头，而肖娜则直挺挺地坐着，直视前方。

sentences.en: Becky's father,
sentences.zh: 贝姬的父亲

sentences.en: Darren Galsworthy, said, quote,
sentences.zh: 达伦·戈尔斯沃西说，引述如下，

sentences.en: We will never understand why this happened, but we now believe we were just disposable pawns in a plot born out of hatred, jealousy, and greed.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会明白为什么会发生这种事，但我们现在相信，我们只是由仇恨、嫉妒和贪婪孕育出的阴谋中的用完即弃的棋子。

sentences.en: The heartless, cold, and calculating perpetrators of this despicable act of evil can never be forgotten or forgiven.
sentences.zh: 这起卑鄙邪恶行径中冷酷无情、精于算计的作案者永远不能被遗忘或原谅。

sentences.en: This act of violence sent shockwaves through not only our family, but the whole country and further afield.
sentences.zh: 这种暴力行为不仅在我们的家庭中，而且在整个国家以及更远的地方都引起了震动。

sentences.en: The betrayal we feel is insurmountable.
sentences.zh: 我们感受到的背叛感是无法逾越的。

sentences.en: It would have been much kinder to have killed us all than to have to cope with the aftermath of this crime.
sentences.zh: 把我们全部杀掉，也比必须应对这起犯罪带来的后果要仁慈得多。

sentences.en: Not only did they cruelly rob Becky of her life, they also took her dignity in death.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅残忍地剥夺了贝姬的生命，还在她死后剥夺了她的尊严。

sentences.en: When I close my eyes to go to sleep, I see Becky's death over and over again.
sentences.zh: 当我闭上眼睛准备睡觉时，我一遍又一遍地看到贝姬的死。

sentences.en: I see what they did to my child.
sentences.zh: 我看到他们对我的孩子做了什么。

sentences.en: I hear her cry out,
sentences.zh: 我听到她大喊，

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你们在干什么？

sentences.en: Then I feel her terror as she realises they are not going to stop and she is about to die.
sentences.zh: 然后我感受到了她的恐惧，因为她意识到他们不会停手，而她即将死去。

sentences.en: I feel her heart racing.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到她的心跳加速。

sentences.en: I see all this, and I am powerless to help her.
sentences.zh: 我看到了这一切，但我却无能为力去帮她。

sentences.en: All too frequently, I awake drenched in sweat and physically shaking.
sentences.zh: 太频繁了，我醒来时大汗淋漓，身体颤抖。

sentences.en: Becky was so small and fragile, she never stood a chance.
sentences.zh: 贝姬那么小，那么脆弱，她根本没有机会生还。

sentences.en: These nightmares consume my every thought, like advanced cancer.
sentences.zh: 这些噩梦吞噬着我的每一个念头，就像晚期癌症一样。

sentences.en: They haunt my days and terrorise my nights.
sentences.zh: 它们萦绕着我的白天，折磨着我的夜晚。

sentences.en: This is the reality of what transpired that day, a legacy I cannot escape.
sentences.zh: 这就是那天发生的事情的现实，是我无法摆脱的精神遗产。

sentences.en: At this time, I pray that the law and justice will go hand in hand, and the sentence will fit this evil act of murder and butchery.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，我祈祷法律与正义能够携手并进，判决能够配得上这桩邪恶的谋杀和残害行径。

sentences.en: Becky's biological mother, Tanya Watts, spoke of being haunted by images of her daughter's little wrist in the mortuary, with a bandage covering the horrific cut marks.
sentences.zh: 贝姬的亲生母亲塔尼亚·沃茨谈到，女儿在停尸房里的小手腕上缠着绷带，覆盖着可怕的割伤痕迹的画面一直萦绕在她的脑海中。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用原话，

sentences.en: Every day has been a living nightmare, and as if that wasn't bad enough, for some reason my daughter was not only murdered, but she was mutilated and cut into pieces.
sentences.zh: 每一天都是活生生的噩梦，仿佛这还不够糟糕，出于某种原因，我的女儿不仅被谋杀，她还被残害并切成了碎块。

sentences.en: It's the worst of all horror movies, but this is real.
sentences.zh: 这是最糟糕的恐怖电影，但这是现实。

sentences.en: This is my child.
sentences.zh: 这是我的孩子。

sentences.en: Based on evidence presented at trial, Justice James Dingmans accepted that the alleged kidnapping and subsequent murder of Becky Watts had been a sexually motivated plan
sentences.zh: 根据审判中出示的证据，法官詹姆斯·丁曼斯接受了关于对贝姬·沃茨的涉嫌绑架及随后的谋杀是一个有性动机的计划的认定，

sentences.en: orchestrated by both Nathan Matthews and Shauna Hoare, with Shauna pandering to Nathan's perversions and acting his subordinate.
sentences.zh: 该计划由南森·马修斯和肖娜·霍尔共同策划，肖娜迎合了南森的变态心理并充当他的下属。

sentences.en: He did not accept Shauna's claims of ignorance, stating she was either the unluckiest, most naive person in the world, or clearly, she knew what was going on.
sentences.zh: 他不接受肖娜对一无所知的辩解，并表示她要么是世界上最倒霉、最天真的人，要么很显然，她对发生的事情心知肚明。

sentences.en: Justice Dingmans noted the couple's deceit of their own family as particularly cruel and unusual.
sentences.zh: 丁曼斯法官指出，这对情侣对自己的家人进行欺骗尤其残酷和不寻常。

sentences.en: His eyes welled with tears, and his voice broke as he spoke of Becky's family.
sentences.zh: 当他谈到贝姬的家人时，他的眼眶涌出了泪水，声音也哽咽了。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用原话，

sentences.en: I should like to pay public tribute to the family of Becky for the dignified way in which they have conducted themselves.
sentences.zh: 我要公开向贝姬的家人表达敬意，感谢他们表现出的尊严。

sentences.en: Hearing the evidence during the trial has been difficult for anyone, but it is plain that it has been an immense burden for the family.
sentences.zh: 在审判期间听取证据对任何人来说都是困难的，但很显然，这对家属来说是一个巨大的负担。

sentences.en: Taking into account that Nathan nor Shauna had shown any remorse for their actions, and both still refused to speak truthfully about what really happened to Becky,
sentences.zh: 考虑到南森和肖娜对自己的行为都没有表现出任何悔意，且两人依然拒绝说出关于贝姬真实遭遇的实话，

sentences.en: Justice Dingmans sentenced Nathan Matthews to a mandatory life sentence.
sentences.zh: 丁曼斯法官判处南森·马修斯强制终身监禁。

sentences.en: With a minimum term of 33 years.
sentences.zh: 最低服刑期为33年。

sentences.en: Shauna Hoare was sentenced to 17 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 肖娜·霍尔被判处17年监禁。

sentences.en: Subsequent appeals have been rejected.
sentences.zh: 随后的上诉均已被驳回。

sentences.en: Carl Demetrius and Jaden Parsons, the couple who let Nathan Matthews store Becky's body parts in their garden shed on Barton Court, both pled guilty to assisting an offender.
sentences.zh: 卡尔·德米特里乌斯和杰登·帕森斯，这对允许南森·马修斯将贝姬的身体部位存放在他们巴顿法院花园棚里的情侣，均对协助犯罪嫌疑人罪名认罪。

sentences.en: Judge Neil Ford accepted the couple's defence that they did not know what Nathan's suitcases contained.
sentences.zh: 法官尼尔·福特接受了这对情侣的辩解，即他们不知道南森的行李箱里装着什么。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用原话，

sentences.en: You both knew Nathan Matthews, but neither of you could have imagined that he was capable of the levels of depravity to which he descended.
sentences.zh: 你们两个都认识南森·马修斯，但你们谁也没有想到他会堕落到如此令人发指的堕落程度。

sentences.en: You had unwittingly agreed to the hiding of the body of Rebecca Watts and objects connected to her abduction, killing, and dismemberment.
sentences.zh: 你们在不知情的情况下同意隐藏丽贝卡·沃茨的尸体以及与她的绑架、谋杀和肢解有关的物品。

sentences.en: You were motivated by money, and knew that you were assisting Matthews to hide items which you believed were linked to a relevant offence.
sentences.zh: 你们是出于金钱动机，并且知道你们是在协助马修斯隐藏你们认为与相关犯罪有关的物品。

sentences.en: Those who assist offenders in ignorance of the offence that has been committed take a risk, and the punishment that follows must reflect the offence that has been committed.
sentences.zh: 那些在对所犯罪行一无所知的情况下协助罪犯的人是在冒风险，随之而来的惩罚必须反映所犯的罪行。

sentences.en: Carl Demetrius was sentenced to two years prison, and Jaden Parsons to 16 months for their involvement with the crime.
sentences.zh: 因涉嫌此案，卡尔·德米特里乌斯被判处两年监禁，杰登·帕森斯被判处16个月监禁。

sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·艾兰（帮助卡尔·德米特里乌斯搬运行李箱的人）以及卡尔的孪生兄弟多诺万·德米特里乌斯（他也住在巴顿法院

sentences.zh: 他们都声称没有参与这起犯罪，最终被判无罪并洗脱了所有罪名。

sentences.en: After the trial, the Bristol community continued to show their support for Becky Watts and her family.
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，布里斯托尔社区继续表达对贝姬·沃茨及其家人的支持。

sentences.en: A lamppost was placed in one of
sentences.zh: 一根路灯柱被安置在

sentences.en: Becky's favourite places, St George Park, to pay tribute to her memory every time it lit up.
sentences.zh: 贝姬最喜欢的地方之一——圣乔治公园，每当灯亮起时，以此来缅怀她的记忆。

sentences.en: An apple tree was planted in Becky's honour at the Meadowvale Community Centre, and a memorial bench was placed in Plumber's Hill, close to her home.
sentences.zh: 在梅多维尔社区中心为贝姬荣誉种植了一棵苹果树，并在靠近她家的普卢默斯山放置了一张纪念长椅。

sentences.en: Lastly, a mural was painted featuring Becky's name in bold lettering.
sentences.zh: 最后，绘制了一幅壁画，上面用粗体字写着贝姬的名字。

sentences.zh: 文字上半部分涂成粉红色，下半部分涂成蓝色。

sentences.en: Angie Gaulsworthy's health deteriorated following the tragedy, as the horror that her own son was responsible for her beloved stepdaughter's death took its toll.
sentences.zh: 在这场悲剧之后，安吉·戈尔斯沃西的健康状况恶化了，因为她亲生儿子要为她深爱的继女之死负责这一恐怖事实对她造成了沉重打击。

sentences.en: Despite this, she hoped to one day summon the courage to confront Nathan in prison, and find out the truth of what exactly happened on February 19, 2015.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是希望有一天能鼓起勇气在监狱里与南森对质，找出2015年2月19日那天到底发生了什么的真相。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用原话，

sentences.en: I want to know why it happened.
sentences.zh: 我想知道为什么会发生这种事。

sentences.en: I just want to see that he feels guilty.
sentences.zh: 我只想看到他感到内疚。

sentences.en: I want to know that he understands what he's done, not only to Becky, but to me as well.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他明白他所做的事，不仅是对贝姬，也是对我的伤害。

sentences.en: I want him to know that he's destroyed my life, and that soon I'll be dead, and I'll die broken-hearted.
sentences.zh: 我要让他知道他毁了我的生活，很快我就会死去，我将带着心碎死去。

sentences.en: I'll ask him why.
sentences.zh: 我会问他为什么。

sentences.en: I'll tell Nathan I can never forgive him for what he's done.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉南森，我永远不会原谅他所做的一切。

sentences.en: I'll explain this will be the last time he ever sets eyes on his mother.
sentences.zh: 我会解释这将是他最后一次见到他的母亲。

sentences.en: The last time I see my son.
sentences.zh: 这也是我最后一次见到我的儿子。

sentences.en: The last chance to look into his eyes.
sentences.zh: 这是最后一次看着他的眼睛的机会。

sentences.en: I think I love him, but I'm not really sure now.
sentences.zh: 我想我是爱他的，但我现在真的不确定了。

sentences.en: He's done what he's done.
sentences.zh: 他做过的事已经无法改变。

sentences.en: But I'm still his mother.
sentences.zh: 但我依然是他的母亲。

sentences.en: Angie's dying wish is to be buried next to Becky, the girl she raised as her own daughter.
sentences.zh: 安吉临终前的愿望是能葬在贝基身旁，那个她视如己出抚养长大的女孩。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是，

sentences.en: I want to be buried with Becky, the beautiful girl my son took away from us.
sentences.zh: 我想和贝基合葬，那个被我儿子从我们身边夺走的漂亮女孩。

sentences.en: We were inseparable from the time she was a baby.
sentences.zh: 从她还是个小婴儿起，我们就形影不离。

sentences.en: He keeps the door to Becky's old bedroom locked to ensure everything inside remains exactly as it was the day she died.
sentences.zh: 他将贝基旧卧室的房门紧锁，以确保里面的每一样东西都保持着她去世当天的原样。

sentences.en: A timeless memorial to his only daughter.
sentences.zh: 这是对她唯一的女儿永恒的纪念。

sentences.zh: 达伦深情地重温了关于贝基的家庭录像，

sentences.zh: 在录像中，

sentences.zh: 贝基勇敢地举起叉子，上面沾满了极其辛辣的咖喱。

sentences.en: After a few hesitant nibbles, she begins woofing down the meal, telling her dad with a wry smile that it's easy, as her face starts to redden and break out with sweat.
sentences.zh: 在几次犹豫的品尝之后，她开始狼吞虎咽起来，脸上泛红并冒出汗珠，同时带着调侃的微笑告诉爸爸这很简单。

sentences.en: In a tribute to her daughter, Tanya Watts said, quote,
sentences.zh: 为了表达对女儿的缅怀，谭雅·沃茨说道，

sentences.en: I would like to say a big thank you to everyone who took my beautiful angel into their hearts.
sentences.zh: 我想对所有把我的漂亮天使放在心上的人表示由衷的感谢。

sentences.en: I have felt unable to say anything about Becky until now, as the sense of loss and pain is overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 直到现在我才觉得能够开口谈论贝基，因为那种失落感和痛苦实在是太沉重了。

sentences.en: But throughout this time, I have been so touched and comforted by how people, many of whom are complete strangers, have taken the time to express their condolences.
sentences.zh: 但在整个过程中，人们——其中许多人甚至是素不相识的陌生人——花时间来表达他们的哀悼，这深深触动并安慰了我。

sentences.en: I feel Becky's presence all around me.
sentences.zh: 我感觉贝基的陪伴无处不在。

sentences.en: I know that she is up in heaven with her nanny and grampy and other people that loved her.
sentences.zh: 我知道她在天堂里，和她的外公外婆以及其他爱她的人在一起。

sentences.en: Thank you to all those people who helped search for Becky and got our angel returned to us.
sentences.zh: 感谢所有那些帮忙搜寻贝基并让我们的天使回到我们身边的人。

sentences.en: We were able to see each other one last time.
sentences.zh: 我们得以见彼此最后一面。

sentences.en: I know that she is at peace and can now have the dignity that she deserves.
sentences.zh: 我知道她现在内心平静，并且能够拥有她应得的尊严。

sentences.en: I am determined to focus on happy memories of Becky as a beautiful baby and gorgeous girl.
sentences.zh: 我决心专注于关于贝基的快乐回忆，记住她作为可爱婴儿和漂亮女孩的样子。

sentences.en: I have been going through old photographs and she has a beaming smile in all of them.
sentences.zh: 我一直在翻看旧照片，照片上的她每一张都带着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: This is how she should be remembered.
sentences.zh: 这才是她应该被记住的样子。

sentences.en: For her beauty inside and out.
sentences.zh: 为了她由内而外的美丽。
